-- Generated by build-bundle.js from src/. Do not edit manually.
local __modules = {}
local __cache = {}

local function __require(name)
    if __cache[name] ~= nil then
        return __cache[name]
    end

    local loader = __modules[name]
    if not loader then
        error("AcrylicUI bundle missing module: " .. tostring(name), 2)
    end

    local value = loader()
    __cache[name] = value
    return value
end
__modules["Components.Button"] = function()
--[[
    AcrylicUI - Button Component

    A clickable button with hover effects and icon support.
]]

local Create = require(script.Parent.Parent.Utils.Create)
local BaseComponent = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.BaseComponent)
local Tween = require(script.Parent.Parent.Utils.Tween)
local Colors = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Colors)
local Sizes = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Sizes)
local Defaults = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Defaults)
local Icons = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Icons)

local Button = {}
Button.__index = Button
setmetatable(Button, { __index = BaseComponent })
local ComponentDefaults = Defaults.Components or {}
local CommonDefaults = ComponentDefaults.Common or {}
local ButtonDefaults = ComponentDefaults.Button or {}
local ComponentIcons = Icons.Components or {}

export type IconValue = string | number

export type ButtonConfig = {
    Name: string?,
    Description: string?,
    Desc: string?,
    Icon: IconValue?,
    Callback: (() -> ())?,
}

export type ButtonObject = {
    SetText: (self: ButtonObject, text: string) -> (),
    SetIcon: (self: ButtonObject, icon: IconValue?) -> (),
    SetCallback: (self: ButtonObject, callback: () -> ()) -> (),
    Block: (self: ButtonObject, text: string?) -> (),
    Unblock: (self: ButtonObject) -> (),
    IsBlocked: (self: ButtonObject) -> boolean,
    Destroy: (self: ButtonObject) -> (),
}

--[[
    Creates a new button component

    @param parent Instance - Parent container
    @param config ButtonConfig - Button configuration
    @return ButtonObject - Button control object

    @example
    local button = Button.new(container, {
        Name = "Execute",
        Icon = "rbxassetid://10734898355",
        Callback = function()
            print("Button clicked!")
        end
    })
]]
function Button.new(parent: Instance, config: ButtonConfig): ButtonObject
    local self
    config = config or {}

    local name = config.Name or ButtonDefaults.Name or "Button"
    local icon = config.Icon or ComponentIcons.Button or "rbxassetid://10734898355"
    local callback = config.Callback or function() end
    local description = Create.GetDescription(config)
    local hasDescription = description ~= nil
    local height = hasDescription
            and (Sizes.Component.HeightWithDescription or CommonDefaults.HeightWithDescription or 50)
        or Sizes.Button.Height

    self = BaseComponent.new(Button, {
        Parent = parent,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height),
        Blockable = true,
    })

    -- Button label
    self._label = Create.ComponentLabel(
        self._frame,
        name,
        hasDescription,
        Sizes.Button.LabelRightPadding or 50
    )

    -- Description
    Create.Description(
        self._frame,
        description,
        UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Component.LabelLeft or 10, 0, Sizes.Component.DescriptionTop or 27),
        UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(Sizes.Button.LabelRightPadding or 50),
            0,
            Sizes.Component.DescriptionHeight or 14
        )
    )

    -- Icon
    self._icon = Create.Instance("ImageLabel", {
        Name = "Icon",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        ImageColor3 = Colors.Text,
        Position = UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(Sizes.Button.IconRightOffset or 30),
            0.5,
            -((Sizes.Button.IconSize or 20) / 2)
        ),
        Size = UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Button.IconSize or 20, 0, Sizes.Button.IconSize or 20),
        Parent = self._frame,
    })
    Create.ApplyIcon(self._icon, icon, ComponentIcons.Button)

    Create.Instance("UIAspectRatioConstraint", {
        Parent = self._icon,
    })

    -- Click button
    self._button = Create.Instance("TextButton", {
        Name = "ClickArea",
        Text = CommonDefaults.EmptyText or "",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    self._callback = callback

    -- Event handlers
    self:Connect(self._button.MouseButton1Click, function()
        if self._blocked then
            return
        end

        -- Click animation
        Tween.Create(
            self._frame,
            { BackgroundTransparency = CommonDefaults.PressedTransparency or 0.2 },
            "Fast"
        )
        task.wait(CommonDefaults.ClickFlashDelay or 0.1)
        Tween.Create(
            self._frame,
            { BackgroundTransparency = CommonDefaults.SurfaceTransparency or 0.4 },
            "Fast"
        )

        self._callback()
    end)

    local enter, leave = Create.HoverEffect(
        self._button,
        self._frame,
        CommonDefaults.HoverTransparency or 0.3,
        CommonDefaults.SurfaceTransparency or 0.4,
        function()
            return not self._blocked
        end
    )
    table.insert(self._connections, enter)
    table.insert(self._connections, leave)

    return self
end

function Button:SetText(text: string)
    self._label.Text = text
end

function Button:SetIcon(icon: IconValue?)
    Create.ApplyIcon(self._icon, icon, ComponentIcons.Button)
end

function Button:SetCallback(callback: () -> ())
    self._callback = callback
end

return Button
end

__modules["Components.ColorPicker"] = function()
local Create = require(script.Parent.Parent.Utils.Create)
local BaseComponent = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.BaseComponent)
local Colors = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Colors)
local Sizes = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Sizes)
local Defaults = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Defaults)
local Layers = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Layers)
local Services = require(script.Parent.Parent.Utils.Services)

local ColorPicker = {}
ColorPicker.__index = ColorPicker
setmetatable(ColorPicker, { __index = BaseComponent })
local ComponentDefaults = Defaults.Components or {}
local CommonDefaults = ComponentDefaults.Common or {}
local ColorPickerDefaults = ComponentDefaults.ColorPicker or {}
local ColorPickerLayers = Layers.ColorPicker or {}
local ColorPickerSizes = Sizes.ColorPicker or {}

-- Minimal color picker: preview + simple palette popup
local PRESETS = ColorPickerDefaults.Presets
    or {
        Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
        Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0),
        Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0),
        Color3.fromRGB(0, 128, 255),
        Color3.fromRGB(255, 128, 0),
        Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 255),
    }

function ColorPicker.new(parent: Instance, config, window)
    config = config or {}

    local name = config.Name or ColorPickerDefaults.Name or "Color Picker"
    local description = Create.GetDescription(config)
    local hasDescription = description ~= nil
    local height = hasDescription
            and (ColorPickerSizes.HeightWithDescription or CommonDefaults.HeightWithDescription or 50)
        or Sizes.Button.Height

    local self = BaseComponent.new(ColorPicker, {
        Parent = parent,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height),
        Blockable = true,
        Flag = config.Flag,
        Window = window,
    })

    self._callback = config.Callback or function() end
    self._color = config.Default or PRESETS[1]

    Create.ComponentLabel(
        self._frame,
        name,
        hasDescription,
        ColorPickerSizes.LabelRightPadding or 50
    )

    Create.Description(
        self._frame,
        description,
        UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Component.LabelLeft or 10, 0, Sizes.Component.DescriptionTop or 27),
        UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(ColorPickerSizes.LabelRightPadding or 50),
            0,
            Sizes.Component.DescriptionHeight or 14
        )
    )

    self._preview = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Preview",
        BackgroundColor3 = self._color,
        Position = UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(ColorPickerSizes.PreviewRightOffset or 45),
            0.5,
            -(ColorPickerSizes.PreviewVerticalOffset or 8)
        ),
        Size = UDim2.new(
            0,
            ColorPickerSizes.PreviewWidth or 35,
            0,
            ColorPickerSizes.PreviewHeight or 16
        ),
        Parent = self._frame,
    })
    Create.Corner(self._preview, Sizes.Corner.Small)
    Create.Stroke(self._preview)

    local previewBtn = Create.Instance("TextButton", {
        Text = CommonDefaults.EmptyText or "",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        Parent = self._preview,
    })

    -- Palette popup
    self._palette = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Palette",
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Secondary,
        BackgroundTransparency = CommonDefaults.ControlTransparency or 0.04,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.new(
            0,
            ColorPickerSizes.PaletteWidth or 160,
            0,
            ColorPickerSizes.PaletteHeight or 70
        ),
        Visible = false,
        ZIndex = ColorPickerLayers.Palette or 2000,
        Parent = parent,
    })
    Create.Corner(self._palette, Sizes.Corner.Medium)
    Create.Stroke(self._palette)
    Create.Padding(
        self._palette,
        ColorPickerSizes.PalettePadding or 8,
        ColorPickerSizes.PalettePadding or 8,
        ColorPickerSizes.PalettePadding or 8,
        ColorPickerSizes.PalettePadding or 8
    )

    Create.Instance("UIGridLayout", {
        CellPadding = UDim2.new(
            0,
            ColorPickerSizes.PaletteCellPadding or 8,
            0,
            ColorPickerSizes.PaletteCellPadding or 8
        ),
        CellSize = UDim2.new(
            0,
            ColorPickerSizes.PaletteSwatchSize or 24,
            0,
            ColorPickerSizes.PaletteSwatchSize or 24
        ),
        Parent = self._palette,
    })

    local function close()
        if self._isOpen then
            self._isOpen = false
            self._palette.Visible = false
            if self._outsideClickConn then
                self._outsideClickConn:Disconnect()
                self._outsideClickConn = nil
            end
        end
    end

    for _, col in ipairs(PRESETS) do
        local swatch = Create.Instance("TextButton", {
            BackgroundColor3 = col,
            Text = CommonDefaults.EmptyText or "",
            Size = UDim2.new(
                0,
                ColorPickerSizes.PaletteSwatchSize or 24,
                0,
                ColorPickerSizes.PaletteSwatchSize or 24
            ),
            Parent = self._palette,
        })
        Create.Corner(swatch, Sizes.Corner.Small)
        Create.Stroke(swatch)
        self:Connect(swatch.MouseButton1Click, function()
            if self._blocked then
                return
            end

            self:SetColor(col)
            close()
        end)
    end

    local function open()
        if self._blocked then
            return
        end

        local p = self._preview.AbsolutePosition
        self._palette.Position = UDim2.new(
            0,
            p.X - (ColorPickerSizes.PaletteWidth or 160) + (ColorPickerSizes.PreviewWidth or 35),
            0,
            p.Y + (ColorPickerSizes.PaletteYOffset or 22)
        )
        self._palette.Visible = true
        self._isOpen = true

        -- Connect outside-click handler
        if not self._outsideClickConn then
            self._outsideClickConn = self:Connect(
                Services.UserInputService.InputBegan,
                function(input, gameProcessed)
                    if gameProcessed then
                        return
                    end
                    if
                        input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                        and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
                    then
                        return
                    end

                    if not self._isOpen then
                        return
                    end

                    local clickPos = input.Position

                    -- Click on palette → let swatch handle it
                    local palPos = self._palette.AbsolutePosition
                    local palSize = self._palette.AbsoluteSize
                    if
                        clickPos.X >= palPos.X
                        and clickPos.X <= palPos.X + palSize.X
                        and clickPos.Y >= palPos.Y
                        and clickPos.Y <= palPos.Y + palSize.Y
                    then
                        return
                    end

                    -- Click on preview → let toggle handle it
                    local prevPos = self._preview.AbsolutePosition
                    local prevSize = self._preview.AbsoluteSize
                    if
                        clickPos.X >= prevPos.X
                        and clickPos.X <= prevPos.X + prevSize.X
                        and clickPos.Y >= prevPos.Y
                        and clickPos.Y <= prevPos.Y + prevSize.Y
                    then
                        return
                    end

                    close()
                end
            )
        end
    end

    self:Connect(previewBtn.MouseButton1Click, function()
        if self._blocked then
            return
        end

        if self._isOpen then
            close()
        else
            open()
        end
    end)

    local baseBlock = self.Block
    self.Block = function(component, text: string?)
        close()
        baseBlock(component, text)
    end

    Create.Configurable(self, self._flag, "ColorPicker", function()
        return {
            R = self._color.R,
            G = self._color.G,
            B = self._color.B,
        }
    end, function(value)
        if
            type(value) == "table"
            and type(value.R) == "number"
            and type(value.G) == "number"
            and type(value.B) == "number"
        then
            self:SetColor(Color3.new(value.R, value.G, value.B))
        elseif typeof(value) == "Color3" then
            self:SetColor(value)
        end
    end)

    return self
end

function ColorPicker:SetColor(color: Color3)
    self._color = color
    self._preview.BackgroundColor3 = color
    self._callback(color)
end

function ColorPicker:GetColor(): Color3
    return self._color
end

function ColorPicker:Destroy()
    if self._palette then
        self._palette:Destroy()
        self._palette = nil
    end

    BaseComponent.Destroy(self)
end

return ColorPicker
end

__modules["Components.ContentSection"] = function()
local Create = require(script.Parent.Parent.Utils.Create)
local Colors = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Colors)
local Sizes = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Sizes)
local Fonts = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Fonts)
local Defaults = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Defaults)
local Icons = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Icons)
local BaseComponent = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.BaseComponent)

local Button = require(script.Parent.Button)
local Toggle = require(script.Parent.Toggle)
local Slider = require(script.Parent.Slider)
local Dropdown = require(script.Parent.Dropdown)
local TextBox = require(script.Parent.TextBox)

local ContentSection = {}
ContentSection.__index = ContentSection
setmetatable(ContentSection, { __index = BaseComponent })

local ComponentDefaults = Defaults.Components or {}
local ConfigUIDefaults = ComponentDefaults.ConfigUI or {}
local ConfigDefaults = Defaults.Config or {}
local MessageDefaults = Defaults.Messages or {}
local NotificationDefaults = Defaults.Notification or {}
local ComponentIcons = Icons.Components or {}
local NotificationIcons = Icons.Notification or {}

function ContentSection.new(tab, config)
    local sectionConfig = if type(config) == "table" then config else { Title = config }
    local title = tostring(sectionConfig.Title or sectionConfig.Name or "Section")
    local description = Create.GetDescription(sectionConfig)
    local hasDescription = description ~= nil
    local headerHeight = hasDescription and 54 or 42

    local self = BaseComponent.new(ContentSection, {
        Parent = tab._content,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
        Blockable = false,
        Window = tab._window,
        Properties = {
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
        },
    })

    self._tab = tab
    self._window = tab._window
    self._title = title
    self._elements = {}
    Create.ListLayout(self._frame, 0)

    self._header = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Header",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, headerHeight),
        LayoutOrder = 0,
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    self._label = Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "Title",
        FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
        Text = title,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        TextSize = Fonts.Size.Section,
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, hasDescription and 7 or 11),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, Sizes.Tab.SectionHeight or 25),
        Parent = self._header,
    })

    self._description = Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "Description",
        FontFace = Fonts.Light,
        TextColor3 = Colors.TextDark,
        Text = description or "",
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        TextSize = Fonts.Size.Tiny,
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 30),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, Sizes.Component.DescriptionHeight or 14),
        Visible = hasDescription,
        Parent = self._header,
    })

    self._separator = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Separator",
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Border,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),
        LayoutOrder = 1,
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    self._container = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Elements",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
        LayoutOrder = 2,
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    Create.Padding(self._container, 10, 10, 10, 10)
    Create.ListLayout(self._container, Sizes.Tab.ContentPadding or 8)

    return self
end

function ContentSection:_AddElement(element)
    table.insert(self._elements, element)
    return element
end

function ContentSection:Paragraph(config)
    local Paragraph = require(script.Parent.Paragraph)
    return self:_AddElement(Paragraph.new(self._container, config))
end

function ContentSection:Button(config)
    return self:_AddElement(Button.new(self._container, config, self._window))
end

function ContentSection:Toggle(config)
    return self:_AddElement(Toggle.new(self._container, config, self._window))
end

function ContentSection:Slider(config)
    return self:_AddElement(Slider.new(self._container, config, self._window))
end

function ContentSection:Dropdown(config)
    return self:_AddElement(Dropdown.new(self._container, config, self._window))
end

function ContentSection:Keybind(config)
    local Keybind = require(script.Parent.Keybind)
    return self:_AddElement(Keybind.new(self._container, config, self._window))
end

function ContentSection:ColorPicker(config)
    local ColorPicker = require(script.Parent.ColorPicker)
    return self:_AddElement(ColorPicker.new(self._container, config, self._window))
end

function ContentSection:TextBox(config)
    return self:_AddElement(TextBox.new(self._container, config, self._window))
end

function ContentSection:CreateConfigSection()
    local function getConfigOptions()
        local configs = self._window:GetConfigs()
        if #configs == 0 then
            return { ConfigDefaults.DefaultName or "default" }
        end
        return configs
    end

    local configNameBox = self:TextBox({
        Name = ConfigUIDefaults.ConfigName or "Config Name",
        Default = self._window._currentConfig,
        Placeholder = ConfigUIDefaults.ConfigPlaceholder or "Enter config name...",
        Callback = function(text)
            self._window._currentConfig = text
        end,
    })

    local configDropdown
    configDropdown = self:Dropdown({
        Name = ConfigUIDefaults.SelectConfig or "Select Config",
        Options = getConfigOptions(),
        Default = self._window._currentConfig,
        Callback = function(selected)
            if type(selected) == "string" then
                configNameBox:SetText(selected)
                self._window._currentConfig = selected
            end
        end,
    })

    self:Button({
        Name = ConfigUIDefaults.SaveConfig or "Save Config",
        Callback = function()
            local configName = configNameBox:GetText()
            if configName ~= "" and self._window:SaveConfig(configName) then
                configDropdown:Refresh(getConfigOptions())
            end
        end,
    })

    self:Button({
        Name = ConfigUIDefaults.LoadConfig or "Load Config",
        Callback = function()
            local configName = configNameBox:GetText()
            if configName ~= "" then
                self._window:LoadConfig(configName)
            end
        end,
    })

    self:Button({
        Name = ConfigUIDefaults.DeleteConfig or "Delete Config",
        Callback = function()
            local configName = configNameBox:GetText()
            if configName ~= "" and self._window:DeleteConfig(configName) then
                configDropdown:Refresh(getConfigOptions())
            end
        end,
    })

    self:Button({
        Name = ConfigUIDefaults.RefreshConfigs or "Refresh Configs",
        Callback = function()
            configDropdown:Refresh(getConfigOptions())
            self._window:Notify({
                Title = MessageDefaults.ConfigsRefreshedTitle or "Configs Refreshed",
                Description = MessageDefaults.ConfigsRefreshedDescription or "Config list updated",
                Duration = NotificationDefaults.SuccessDuration or 2,
                Icon = NotificationIcons.Config
                    or ComponentIcons.Config
                    or "rbxassetid://10723356507",
            })
        end,
    })

    self:Toggle({
        Name = ConfigUIDefaults.AutoSave or "Auto Save",
        Default = false,
        Callback = function(enabled)
            self._window:SetAutoSave(enabled)
        end,
    })

    local autoLoadToggle = self:Toggle({
        Name = ConfigUIDefaults.AutoLoad or "Auto Load",
        Default = self._window:GetAutoLoad(),
        Callback = function(enabled)
            if not self._window:SetAutoLoad(enabled) then
                autoLoadToggle:SetValue(not enabled, true)
            end
        end,
    })

    return {
        RefreshConfigs = function()
            configDropdown:Refresh(getConfigOptions())
        end,
    }
end

function ContentSection:Destroy()
    for _, element in ipairs(self._elements) do
        if element.Destroy then
            element:Destroy()
        end
    end
    table.clear(self._elements)

    BaseComponent.Destroy(self)
end

return ContentSection
end

__modules["Components.Dropdown"] = function()
--[[
    AcrylicUI - Dropdown Component

    A dropdown menu with single/multi-select support.
]]

local Create = require(script.Parent.Parent.Utils.Create)
local BaseComponent = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.BaseComponent)
local Tween = require(script.Parent.Parent.Utils.Tween)
local Colors = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Colors)
local Sizes = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Sizes)
local Fonts = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Fonts)
local Defaults = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Defaults)
local Icons = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Icons)
local Layers = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Layers)

local Dropdown = {}
Dropdown.__index = Dropdown
setmetatable(Dropdown, { __index = BaseComponent })
local ComponentDefaults = Defaults.Components or {}
local CommonDefaults = ComponentDefaults.Common or {}
local DropdownDefaults = ComponentDefaults.Dropdown or {}
local ComponentIcons = Icons.Components or {}
local DropdownLayers = Layers.Dropdown or {}
local DropdownSizes = Sizes.Dropdown or {}
local SELECTED_ICON = ComponentIcons.DropdownSelected or "rbxassetid://16898669433"
local SEARCH_ICON = ComponentIcons.DropdownSearch or "rbxassetid://16898734242"

local function ResolveSearchConfig(searchConfig, name: string): (boolean, string)
    if searchConfig == true then
        return true, "Search " .. name .. "..."
    end

    if type(searchConfig) == "string" then
        return true, searchConfig
    end

    if type(searchConfig) == "table" then
        local enabled = if searchConfig.Enabled == nil then true else searchConfig.Enabled == true
        local placeholder = searchConfig.Placeholder or "Search " .. name .. "..."
        return enabled, tostring(placeholder)
    end

    return false, ""
end

export type DropdownConfig = {
    Name: string?,
    Description: string?,
    Desc: string?,
    Options: { string }?,
    Default: string | { string }?,
    MultiSelect: boolean?,
    Search: boolean | string | { Enabled: boolean?, Placeholder: string? }?,
    Flag: string?,
    Callback: ((selected: string | { string }) -> ())?,
}

export type DropdownObject = {
    SetValue: (self: DropdownObject, value: string | { string }) -> (),
    GetValue: (self: DropdownObject) -> string | { string },
    Refresh: (self: DropdownObject, options: { string }) -> (),
    Open: (self: DropdownObject) -> (),
    Close: (self: DropdownObject) -> (),
    Block: (self: DropdownObject, text: string?) -> (),
    Unblock: (self: DropdownObject) -> (),
    IsBlocked: (self: DropdownObject) -> boolean,
    Destroy: (self: DropdownObject) -> (),
}

--[[
    Creates a new dropdown component

    @param parent Instance - Parent container
    @param config DropdownConfig - Dropdown configuration
    @return DropdownObject - Dropdown control object
]]
function Dropdown.new(parent: Instance, config: DropdownConfig, window): DropdownObject
    local self
    config = config or {}

    local name = config.Name or DropdownDefaults.Name or "Dropdown"
    local options = config.Options
        or DropdownDefaults.Options
        or { "Option 1", "Option 2", "Option 3" }
    local multiSelect = if config.MultiSelect == nil
        then (DropdownDefaults.MultiSelect or false)
        else config.MultiSelect
    local callback = config.Callback or function() end
    local searchEnabled, searchPlaceholder = ResolveSearchConfig(config.Search, name)
    local description = Create.GetDescription(config)
    local hasDescription = description ~= nil
    local height = hasDescription
            and (DropdownSizes.HeightWithDescription or CommonDefaults.HeightWithDescription or 50)
        or Sizes.Dropdown.Height

    local selected = if multiSelect
        then (if type(config.Default) == "table" then config.Default else {})
        else config.Default or options[1]

    self = BaseComponent.new(Dropdown, {
        Parent = parent,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height),
        Blockable = true,
        Flag = config.Flag,
        Window = window,
    })

    self._options = options
    self._multiSelect = multiSelect
    self._callback = callback
    self._expanded = false
    self._selected = selected
    self._searchEnabled = searchEnabled
    self._searchPlaceholder = searchPlaceholder
    self._searchText = ""

    self._label = Create.ComponentLabel(
        self._frame,
        name,
        hasDescription,
        DropdownSizes.LabelRightPadding or 120
    )

    -- Description
    Create.Description(
        self._frame,
        description,
        UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Component.LabelLeft or 10, 0, Sizes.Component.SectionHeaderHeight or 25),
        UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(DropdownSizes.DescriptionRightPadding or 155),
            0,
            Sizes.Component.DescriptionHeight or 14
        )
    )

    -- Selected display
    self._display = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Display",
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Secondary,
        BackgroundTransparency = CommonDefaults.ControlTransparency or 0.04,
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
        Position = UDim2.new(1, -(DropdownSizes.DisplayRightOffset or 145), 0.5, 0),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.new(
            0,
            DropdownSizes.DisplayWidth or 135,
            0,
            DropdownSizes.DisplayHeight or 26
        ),
        ZIndex = DropdownLayers.Display or 2,
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    Create.Corner(self._display, Sizes.Corner.Medium)
    Create.Stroke(self._display)

    -- Selected label
    self._selectedLabel = Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "SelectedLabel",
        FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
        Text = self:_GetDisplayText(),
        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        TextSize = Fonts.Size.Small,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -(DropdownSizes.SelectedLabelRightPadding or 30), 1, 0),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, DropdownSizes.SelectedLabelPadding or 10, 0, 0),
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        ZIndex = DropdownLayers.Display or 2,
        Parent = self._display,
    })

    -- Arrow indicator
    self._arrow = Create.Instance("ImageLabel", {
        Name = "Arrow",
        ImageColor3 = Colors.TextDark,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Position = UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(DropdownSizes.ArrowRightOffset or 20),
            0.5,
            -(DropdownSizes.ArrowVerticalOffset or 5)
        ),
        Size = UDim2.new(0, DropdownSizes.ArrowSize or 10, 0, DropdownSizes.ArrowSize or 10),
        Rotation = 0,
        ZIndex = DropdownLayers.Display or 2,
        Parent = self._display,
    })
    Create.ApplyIcon(self._arrow, nil, ComponentIcons.Arrow)

    -- Create options container
    self:_CreateOptionsContainer()

    -- Toggle button
    local toggleBtn = Create.Instance("TextButton", {
        Name = "ToggleButton",
        Text = CommonDefaults.EmptyText or "",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        ZIndex = DropdownLayers.ToggleButton or 3,
        Parent = self._display,
    })

    self:Connect(toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click, function()
        if self._blocked then
            return
        end

        if self._expanded then
            self:Close()
        else
            self:Open()
        end
    end)

    local contentContainer = self:_GetContentContainer()
    if contentContainer then
        self:Connect(contentContainer:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanvasPosition"), function()
            if self._expanded then
                self:Close()
            end
        end)
    end

    local popupParent = self:_GetPopupParent()
    self:Connect(popupParent:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), function()
        if self._expanded then
            self:_PositionOptionsContainer(#self:_GetFilteredOptions())
        end
    end)

    self:Connect(self._display:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsolutePosition"), function()
        if self._expanded then
            self:_PositionOptionsContainer(#self:_GetFilteredOptions())
        end
    end)

    self:Connect(self._display:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"), function()
        if self._expanded then
            self:_PositionOptionsContainer(#self:_GetFilteredOptions())
        end
    end)

    local baseBlock = self.Block
    self.Block = function(component, text: string?)
        component:Close()
        baseBlock(component, text)
    end

    Create.Configurable(self, self._flag, "Dropdown", function()
        return self._selected
    end, function(value)
        if self._multiSelect then
            if type(value) == "table" then
                self:SetValue(value, true)
            end
        elseif type(value) == "string" then
            self:SetValue(value, true)
        end
    end)

    return self
end

function Dropdown:_GetDisplayText(): string
    if self._multiSelect then
        if #self._selected == 0 then
            return DropdownDefaults.NoneText or "None"
        end
        return table.concat(self._selected, DropdownDefaults.Separator or ", ")
    end
    return tostring(self._selected)
end

function Dropdown:_GetSearchAreaHeight(): number
    if not self._searchEnabled then
        return 0
    end

    return (DropdownSizes.SearchHeight or 34) + (DropdownSizes.SearchSeparatorHeight or 1)
end

function Dropdown:_GetFilteredOptions(): { string }
    local searchText = string.lower(tostring(self._searchText or ""))
    if not self._searchEnabled or searchText == "" then
        return self._options
    end

    local filtered = {}
    for _, option in ipairs(self._options) do
        if string.find(string.lower(tostring(option)), searchText, 1, true) then
            table.insert(filtered, option)
        end
    end

    return filtered
end

function Dropdown:_IsSelected(option: string): boolean
    if self._multiSelect then
        return table.find(self._selected, option) ~= nil
    end

    return self._selected == option
end

function Dropdown:_GetPopupHeight(visibleCount: number): number
    local maxVisible = DropdownSizes.MaxVisibleOptions or Sizes.Dropdown.MaxVisibleOptions
    local optionHeight = DropdownSizes.OptionHeight or Sizes.Dropdown.OptionHeight
    local searchAreaHeight = self:_GetSearchAreaHeight()
    local contentHeight = if visibleCount == 0
        then (DropdownSizes.EmptyHeight or 42)
        else math.min(visibleCount, maxVisible) * optionHeight

    return searchAreaHeight + contentHeight
end

function Dropdown:_GetPopupParent(): Instance
    if self._window and self._window.GetPopupLayer then
        local ok, popupLayer = pcall(function()
            return self._window:GetPopupLayer()
        end)

        if ok and popupLayer then
            return popupLayer
        end
    end

    return self._frame
end

function Dropdown:_GetContentContainer(): ScrollingFrame?
    if self._window and self._window.GetContentContainer then
        local ok, contentContainer = pcall(function()
            return self._window:GetContentContainer()
        end)

        if ok and contentContainer then
            return contentContainer
        end
    end

    return nil
end

function Dropdown:_UpdateOptionsLayout(visibleCount: number, popupHeight: number?)
    local width = DropdownSizes.DisplayWidth or 135
    local searchAreaHeight = self:_GetSearchAreaHeight()
    local resolvedPopupHeight = popupHeight or self:_GetPopupHeight(visibleCount)
    local scrollHeight = math.max(0, resolvedPopupHeight - searchAreaHeight)
    local optionHeight = DropdownSizes.OptionHeight or Sizes.Dropdown.OptionHeight

    self._optionsContainer.Size = UDim2.new(0, width, 0, resolvedPopupHeight)
    self._optionsScroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, searchAreaHeight)
    self._optionsScroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, scrollHeight)
    self._optionsScroll.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, visibleCount * optionHeight)

    if self._emptyState then
        self._emptyState.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, searchAreaHeight)
        self._emptyState.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, scrollHeight)
    end
end

function Dropdown:_PositionOptionsContainer(visibleCount: number)
    local popupParent = self:_GetPopupParent()
    if self._optionsContainer.Parent ~= popupParent then
        self._optionsContainer.Parent = popupParent
    end

    local margin = DropdownSizes.PopupMargin or 4
    local width = DropdownSizes.DisplayWidth or self._display.AbsoluteSize.X
    local desiredHeight = self:_GetPopupHeight(visibleCount)
    local parentPosition = popupParent.AbsolutePosition
    local parentSize = popupParent.AbsoluteSize
    local displayPosition = self._display.AbsolutePosition
    local displaySize = self._display.AbsoluteSize

    local relativeX = displayPosition.X - parentPosition.X
    local belowY = displayPosition.Y
        - parentPosition.Y
        + displaySize.Y
        - (DropdownSizes.PopupOverlap or 1)
    local aboveBottomY = displayPosition.Y - parentPosition.Y + (DropdownSizes.PopupOverlap or 1)
    local availableBelow = parentSize.Y - belowY - margin
    local availableAbove = aboveBottomY - margin
    local openUp = desiredHeight > availableBelow and availableAbove > availableBelow
    local availableHeight = math.max(0, if openUp then availableAbove else availableBelow)
    local resolvedHeight = math.min(desiredHeight, availableHeight)

    if resolvedHeight <= 0 then
        resolvedHeight = math.min(desiredHeight, parentSize.Y)
    end

    local maxX = math.max(margin, parentSize.X - width - margin)
    local relativeY = if openUp then aboveBottomY - resolvedHeight else belowY
    local maxY = math.max(margin, parentSize.Y - resolvedHeight - margin)

    self._optionsContainer.Position =
        UDim2.new(0, math.clamp(relativeX, margin, maxX), 0, math.clamp(relativeY, margin, maxY))
    self:_UpdateOptionsLayout(visibleCount, resolvedHeight)
end

function Dropdown:_CreateOptionsContainer()
    local totalHeight = self:_GetPopupHeight(#self._options)

    self._optionsContainer = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "OptionsContainer",
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Secondary,
        BackgroundTransparency = CommonDefaults.ControlTransparency or 0.04,
        Position = UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(DropdownSizes.DisplayRightOffset or 145),
            0,
            self._frame.AbsoluteSize.Y - (DropdownSizes.PopupOverlap or 1)
        ),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.new(0, DropdownSizes.DisplayWidth or 135, 0, totalHeight),
        Visible = false,
        ZIndex = DropdownLayers.Options or 100,
        ClipsDescendants = true,
        Parent = self:_GetPopupParent(),
    })

    Create.Corner(self._optionsContainer, Sizes.Corner.Medium)
    Create.Stroke(self._optionsContainer)

    if self._searchEnabled then
        self._searchContainer = Create.Instance("Frame", {
            Name = "Search",
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, DropdownSizes.SearchHeight or 34),
            ZIndex = (DropdownLayers.Options or 100) + 1,
            Parent = self._optionsContainer,
        })

        local searchIcon = Create.Instance("ImageLabel", {
            Name = "SearchIcon",
            ImageColor3 = Colors.TextDark,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Position = UDim2.new(
                0,
                DropdownSizes.SearchIconLeft or 10,
                0.5,
                -((DropdownSizes.SearchIconSize or 16) / 2)
            ),
            Size = UDim2.new(
                0,
                DropdownSizes.SearchIconSize or 16,
                0,
                DropdownSizes.SearchIconSize or 16
            ),
            ZIndex = (DropdownLayers.Options or 100) + 2,
            Parent = self._searchContainer,
        })
        Create.ApplyIcon(searchIcon, nil, SEARCH_ICON)

        self._searchInput = Create.Instance("TextBox", {
            Name = "SearchInput",
            FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
            TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
            PlaceholderText = self._searchPlaceholder,
            PlaceholderColor3 = Colors.TextDark,
            Text = "",
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            ClearTextOnFocus = false,
            TextSize = Fonts.Size.Small,
            Position = UDim2.new(0, DropdownSizes.SearchTextLeft or 34, 0, 0),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -((DropdownSizes.SearchTextLeft or 34) + 10), 1, 0),
            ZIndex = (DropdownLayers.Options or 100) + 2,
            Parent = self._searchContainer,
        })

        self:Connect(self._searchInput:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"), function()
            self._searchText = self._searchInput.Text
            self:_PopulateOptions()
        end)

        Create.Instance("Frame", {
            Name = "SearchSeparator",
            BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Border,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, DropdownSizes.SearchHeight or 34),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, DropdownSizes.SearchSeparatorHeight or 1),
            ZIndex = (DropdownLayers.Options or 100) + 1,
            Parent = self._optionsContainer,
        })
    end

    self._optionsScroll = Create.Instance("ScrollingFrame", {
        Name = "Scroll",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, self:_GetSearchAreaHeight()),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -self:_GetSearchAreaHeight()),
        CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, #self._options * (DropdownSizes.OptionHeight or 30)),
        ScrollBarThickness = DropdownSizes.ScrollbarThickness or 3,
        ScrollBarImageColor3 = Colors.Scrollbar,
        ScrollBarImageTransparency = 0.7,
        ZIndex = DropdownLayers.Options or 100,
        Parent = self._optionsContainer,
    })

    Create.ListLayout(self._optionsScroll, 0)

    self._emptyState = Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "EmptyState",
        FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Colors.TextDark,
        Text = "Not found any",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        TextSize = Fonts.Size.Small,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
        TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, self:_GetSearchAreaHeight()),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -self:_GetSearchAreaHeight()),
        Visible = false,
        ZIndex = (DropdownLayers.Options or 100) + 1,
        Parent = self._optionsContainer,
    })

    self:_PopulateOptions()
end

function Dropdown:_PopulateOptions()
    for _, child in ipairs(self._optionsScroll:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("TextButton") then
            child:Destroy()
        end
    end

    local filteredOptions = self:_GetFilteredOptions()
    local hasOptions = #filteredOptions > 0
    if self._expanded then
        self:_PositionOptionsContainer(#filteredOptions)
    else
        self:_UpdateOptionsLayout(#filteredOptions)
    end
    self._optionsScroll.Visible = hasOptions
    if self._emptyState then
        self._emptyState.Visible = not hasOptions
    end

    for _, option in ipairs(filteredOptions) do
        local selected = self:_IsSelected(option)
        local optionBtn = Create.Instance("TextButton", {
            Name = "Option_" .. option,
            Text = CommonDefaults.EmptyText or "",
            AutoButtonColor = false,
            BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Secondary,
            BackgroundTransparency = selected and 0.9 or (CommonDefaults.Transparent or 1),
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
            Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, DropdownSizes.OptionHeight or Sizes.Dropdown.OptionHeight),
            ZIndex = DropdownLayers.Options or 100,
            Parent = self._optionsScroll,
        })

        local selectedIcon = Create.Instance("ImageLabel", {
            Name = "SelectedIcon",
            ImageColor3 = Colors.Text,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Position = UDim2.new(
                0,
                DropdownSizes.OptionIconLeft or 12,
                0.5,
                -((DropdownSizes.OptionIconSize or 14) / 2)
            ),
            Size = UDim2.new(
                0,
                DropdownSizes.OptionIconSize or 14,
                0,
                DropdownSizes.OptionIconSize or 14
            ),
            Visible = selected,
            ZIndex = (DropdownLayers.Options or 100) + 1,
            Parent = optionBtn,
        })
        Create.ApplyIcon(selectedIcon, nil, SELECTED_ICON)

        local optionText = Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
            Name = "OptionText",
            FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
            TextColor3 = selected and Colors.Text or Colors.TextDark,
            Text = option,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            TextSize = Fonts.Size.Small,
            Position = UDim2.new(0, DropdownSizes.OptionTextLeft or 36, 0, 0),
            Size = UDim2.new(
                1,
                -(
                        (DropdownSizes.OptionTextLeft or 36)
                        + (DropdownSizes.OptionTextRightPadding or 10)
                    ),
                1,
                0
            ),
            ZIndex = (DropdownLayers.Options or 100) + 1,
            Parent = optionBtn,
        })

        local function setHoverVisual(hovering: boolean)
            local backgroundTransparency = if hovering
                then (if selected then 0.68 else 0.78)
                else (if selected then 0.9 else (CommonDefaults.Transparent or 1))
            local textColor = if hovering or selected then Colors.Text else Colors.TextDark

            Tween.Create(optionBtn, { BackgroundTransparency = backgroundTransparency }, "Fast")
            Tween.Create(optionText, { TextColor3 = textColor }, "Fast")
            if selectedIcon.Visible then
                Tween.Create(selectedIcon, { ImageColor3 = textColor }, "Fast")
            end
        end

        optionBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            setHoverVisual(true)
        end)

        optionBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            setHoverVisual(false)
        end)

        optionBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            if self._blocked then
                return
            end

            if self._multiSelect then
                local index = table.find(self._selected, option)
                if index then
                    table.remove(self._selected, index)
                else
                    table.insert(self._selected, option)
                end
                self:_UpdateDisplay()
                self:_PopulateOptions()
                self._callback(self._selected)
            else
                self._selected = option
                self:_UpdateDisplay()
                self:_PopulateOptions()
                self._callback(self._selected)
                self:Close()
            end
        end)
    end
end

function Dropdown:_UpdateDisplay()
    self._selectedLabel.Text = self:_GetDisplayText()
end

function Dropdown:Open()
    if self._blocked then
        return
    end

    self._expanded = true
    self:_PopulateOptions()
    self._optionsContainer.Visible = true
    Tween.Create(self._arrow, { Rotation = 180 }, "Normal")
    self._frame.ZIndex = DropdownLayers.Open or 10
end

function Dropdown:Close()
    self._expanded = false
    self._optionsContainer.Visible = false
    Tween.Create(self._arrow, { Rotation = 0 }, "Normal")
    self._frame.ZIndex = DropdownLayers.Base or 1
end

function Dropdown:SetValue(value: string | { string }, silent: boolean?)
    if self._multiSelect then
        if type(value) == "table" then
            self._selected = value
        end
    else
        self._selected = value
    end
    self:_UpdateDisplay()
    if self._optionsScroll then
        self:_PopulateOptions()
    end
    if not silent then
        self._callback(self._selected)
    end
end

function Dropdown:GetValue(): string | { string }
    return self._selected
end

function Dropdown:Refresh(options: { string })
    self._options = options
    self:_PopulateOptions()
end

function Dropdown:Destroy()
    if self._optionsContainer then
        self._optionsContainer:Destroy()
        self._optionsContainer = nil
    end

    BaseComponent.Destroy(self)
end

return Dropdown
end

__modules["Components.Keybind"] = function()
local Services = require(script.Parent.Parent.Utils.Services)

local Create = require(script.Parent.Parent.Utils.Create)
local BaseComponent = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.BaseComponent)
local Colors = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Colors)
local Sizes = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Sizes)
local Fonts = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Fonts)
local Defaults = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Defaults)

local Keybind = {}
Keybind.__index = Keybind
setmetatable(Keybind, { __index = BaseComponent })
local ComponentDefaults = Defaults.Components or {}
local CommonDefaults = ComponentDefaults.Common or {}
local KeybindDefaults = ComponentDefaults.Keybind or {}
local KeybindSizes = Sizes.Keybind or {}

function Keybind.new(parent: Instance, config, window)
    config = config or {}

    local name = config.Name or KeybindDefaults.Name or "Keybind"
    local default = config.Default or KeybindDefaults.Key or Enum.KeyCode.F
    local callback = config.Callback or function() end
    local description = Create.GetDescription(config)
    local hasDescription = description ~= nil
    local height = hasDescription
            and (KeybindSizes.HeightWithDescription or CommonDefaults.HeightWithDescription or 50)
        or Sizes.Button.Height

    local self = BaseComponent.new(Keybind, {
        Parent = parent,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height),
        Blockable = true,
        Flag = config.Flag,
        Window = window,
    })

    Create.ComponentLabel(self._frame, name, hasDescription)

    Create.Description(
        self._frame,
        description,
        UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Component.LabelLeft or 10, 0, Sizes.Component.DescriptionTop or 27),
        UDim2.new(0, KeybindSizes.LabelWidth or 200, 0, Sizes.Component.DescriptionHeight or 14)
    )

    self._box = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "KeyBox",
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Secondary,
        BackgroundTransparency = CommonDefaults.ControlTransparency or 0.04,
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
        Position = UDim2.new(1, -(KeybindSizes.BoxRightOffset or 10), 0.5, 0),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.new(
            0,
            KeybindSizes.BoxWidth or KeybindDefaults.BoxWidth or 30,
            0,
            KeybindSizes.BoxHeight or 26
        ),
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    Create.Corner(self._box, Sizes.Corner.Small)
    Create.Stroke(self._box)

    self._label = Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "Key",
        FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
        Text = default.Name,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        TextSize = Fonts.Size.Normal,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        Parent = self._box,
    })

    self._listenBtn = Create.Instance("TextButton", {
        Name = "Listen",
        Text = CommonDefaults.EmptyText or "",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        Parent = self._box,
    })

    self._currentKey = default
    self._listening = false

    self._id = name
        .. "_"
        .. tostring(math.floor(os.clock() * (KeybindDefaults.IdClockScale or 1000)))
    window:RegisterKeybind(self._id, self._currentKey, function()
        if self._blocked then
            return
        end

        callback()
    end)

    local function refresh()
        if self._listening then
            self._label.Text = KeybindDefaults.ListeningText or "..."
            self._box.Size = UDim2.new(
                0,
                KeybindSizes.ListeningWidth or KeybindDefaults.ListeningWidth or 43,
                0,
                KeybindSizes.BoxHeight or 26
            )
        else
            local keyName = self._currentKey.Name
            local w = math.max(
                #keyName * (KeybindDefaults.TextWidthScale or 9)
                    + (KeybindDefaults.TextWidthPadding or 10),
                KeybindDefaults.MinWidth or 24
            )
            self._box.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, KeybindSizes.BoxHeight or 26)
            self._label.Text = keyName
        end
    end

    self:Connect(self._listenBtn.MouseButton1Click, function()
        if self._blocked then
            return
        end

        self._listening = true
        refresh()
    end)

    self:Connect(Services.UserInputService.InputBegan, function(input, _gameProcessed)
        if self._blocked then
            return
        end

        if not self._listening then
            return
        end
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
            self._currentKey = input.KeyCode
            self._listening = false
            window:UpdateKeybind(self._id, self._currentKey)
            refresh()
        end
    end)

    self._refresh = refresh

    local baseBlock = self.Block
    self.Block = function(component, text: string?)
        component._listening = false
        component._refresh()
        baseBlock(component, text)
    end

    Create.Configurable(self, self._flag, "Keybind", function()
        return self._currentKey.Name
    end, function(value)
        if type(value) == "string" and Enum.KeyCode[value] then
            self:SetKey(Enum.KeyCode[value])
        elseif typeof(value) == "EnumItem" then
            self:SetKey(value)
        end
    end)

    refresh()
    return self
end

function Keybind:SetKey(key: Enum.KeyCode)
    self._currentKey = key
    self._window:UpdateKeybind(self._id, self._currentKey)
    self._refresh()
end

function Keybind:GetKey(): Enum.KeyCode
    return self._currentKey
end

return Keybind
end

__modules["Components.Paragraph"] = function()
local Create = require(script.Parent.Parent.Utils.Create)
local Colors = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Colors)
local Sizes = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Sizes)
local Fonts = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Fonts)
local Defaults = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Defaults)
local BaseComponent = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.BaseComponent)

local Paragraph = {}
Paragraph.__index = Paragraph
setmetatable(Paragraph, { __index = BaseComponent })
local ComponentDefaults = Defaults.Components or {}
local ParagraphDefaults = ComponentDefaults.Paragraph or {}

function Paragraph.new(parent: Instance, config)
    local self = BaseComponent.new(Paragraph, {
        Parent = parent,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
        Blockable = false,
        Properties = {
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
        },
    })
    local title = (config and config.Title) or ParagraphDefaults.Title or "Paragraph"
    local content = (config and config.Content)
        or ParagraphDefaults.Content
        or "Description text here."

    Create.Padding(self._frame, 10, 10, 10, 10)

    self._title = Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "Title",
        FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
        Text = title,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        TextSize = Fonts.Size.Normal,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, Sizes.Paragraph.TitleHeight or 20),
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    self._content = Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "Content",
        FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Colors.TextDark,
        Text = content,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextWrapped = true,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        TextSize = Fonts.Size.Small,
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, Sizes.Paragraph.ContentTop or 22),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    return self
end

function Paragraph:SetTitle(text: string)
    self._title.Text = text
end

function Paragraph:SetContent(text: string)
    self._content.Text = text
end

return Paragraph
end

__modules["Components.Section"] = function()
local Create = require(script.Parent.Parent.Utils.Create)
local Tween = require(script.Parent.Parent.Utils.Tween)
local Colors = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Colors)
local Fonts = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Fonts)
local Sizes = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Sizes)
local Defaults = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Defaults)
local Icons = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Icons)
local BaseComponent = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.BaseComponent)

local Section = {}
Section.__index = Section
setmetatable(Section, { __index = BaseComponent })
local ComponentIcons = Icons.Components or {}
local CommonDefaults = Defaults.Components and Defaults.Components.Common or {}

function Section.new(window, name: string)
    local self = BaseComponent.new(Section, {
        Parent = window:GetSectionsContainer(),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -(Sizes.Section.FrameRightPadding or 10), 0, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Corner = false,
        Stroke = false,
        Blockable = false,
        Window = window,
        Properties = {
            AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
        },
    })
    self._window = window
    self._name = name
    self._tabs = {}

    Create.ListLayout(self._frame, Sizes.Section.LayoutPadding or 2)

    -- Header container
    local header = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Header",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, Sizes.Section.HeaderHeight or 25),
        LayoutOrder = 0,
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    -- Click area
    local headerBtn = Create.Instance("TextButton", {
        Name = "HeaderButton",
        FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Colors.TextDark,
        Text = CommonDefaults.EmptyText or "",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        Parent = header,
    })

    -- Label
    local label = Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "Label",
        FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Colors.TextDark,
        Text = name,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Position = UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Section.LabelLeft or 5, 0, 0),
        TextSize = Fonts.Size.Small,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -(Sizes.Section.LabelRightPadding or 25), 1, 0),
        Parent = header,
    })

    -- Arrow
    local arrow = Create.Instance("ImageButton", {
        Name = "Arrow",
        ImageColor3 = Colors.TextDark,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Position = UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(Sizes.Section.ArrowRightOffset or 20),
            0.5,
            -(Sizes.Section.ArrowVerticalOffset or 7)
        ),
        Size = UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Section.ArrowSize or 15, 0, Sizes.Section.ArrowSize or 15),
        Rotation = 0,
        Parent = header,
    })
    Create.ApplyIcon(arrow, nil, ComponentIcons.Arrow)

    -- Tabs container
    self._tabsContainer = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Tabs",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
        ClipsDescendants = true,
        LayoutOrder = 1,
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    Create.ListLayout(self._tabsContainer, Sizes.Section.LayoutPadding or 2)
    Create.Padding(self._tabsContainer, 2, 2, Sizes.Section.TabsIndent or 15, 0)

    local expanded = true
    local function toggle()
        expanded = not expanded
        Tween.Create(arrow, { Rotation = expanded and 0 or 180 }, "Normal")
        self._tabsContainer.Visible = expanded
    end

    self:Connect(headerBtn.MouseButton1Click, toggle)
    self:Connect(arrow.MouseButton1Click, toggle)

    self._label = label
    self._arrow = arrow

    return self
end

function Section:CreateTab(name: string, icon: (string | number)?)
    local Tab = require(script.Parent.Tab)
    local tab = Tab.new(self._window, self, name, icon)
    table.insert(self._tabs, tab)
    return tab
end

function Section:Destroy()
    for _, tab in ipairs(self._tabs) do
        if tab.Destroy then
            tab:Destroy()
        end
    end
    table.clear(self._tabs)

    BaseComponent.Destroy(self)
end

return Section
end

__modules["Components.Slider"] = function()
--[[
    AcrylicUI - Slider Component

    A draggable slider for numeric value selection.
]]

local Services = require(script.Parent.Parent.Utils.Services)

local Create = require(script.Parent.Parent.Utils.Create)
local BaseComponent = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.BaseComponent)
local Tween = require(script.Parent.Parent.Utils.Tween)
local Colors = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Colors)
local Sizes = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Sizes)
local Fonts = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Fonts)
local Defaults = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Defaults)

local Slider = {}
Slider.__index = Slider
setmetatable(Slider, { __index = BaseComponent })
local SliderDefaults = Defaults.Slider
local ComponentDefaults = Defaults.Components or {}
local SliderComponentDefaults = ComponentDefaults.Slider or {}

export type SliderConfig = {
    Name: string?,
    Description: string?,
    Desc: string?,
    Min: number?,
    Max: number?,
    Default: number?,
    Increment: number?,
    Flag: string?,
    Callback: ((value: number) -> ())?,
}

export type SliderObject = {
    SetValue: (self: SliderObject, value: number) -> (),
    GetValue: (self: SliderObject) -> number,
    SetMin: (self: SliderObject, min: number) -> (),
    SetMax: (self: SliderObject, max: number) -> (),
    Block: (self: SliderObject, text: string?) -> (),
    Unblock: (self: SliderObject) -> (),
    IsBlocked: (self: SliderObject) -> boolean,
    Destroy: (self: SliderObject) -> (),
}

local function isFiniteNumber(value: any): boolean
    return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value ~= math.huge and value ~= -math.huge
end

local function resolveNumber(value: any, fallback: number): number
    if isFiniteNumber(value) then
        return value
    end

    return fallback
end

local function resolveRange(minValue: any, maxValue: any): (number, number)
    local min = resolveNumber(minValue, SliderDefaults.Min)
    local max = resolveNumber(maxValue, SliderDefaults.Max)

    if max < min then
        min, max = max, min
    end

    return min, max
end

local function resolveIncrement(increment: any): number
    local resolved = resolveNumber(increment, SliderDefaults.Increment)
    if resolved <= 0 then
        return SliderDefaults.Increment
    end

    return resolved
end

local function normalizeValue(
    value: any,
    fallback: number,
    min: number,
    max: number,
    increment: number
): number
    local resolved = resolveNumber(value, fallback)
    local snapped = math.floor(resolved / increment + 0.5) * increment

    return math.clamp(snapped, min, max)
end

--[[
    Creates a new slider component

    @param parent Instance - Parent container
    @param config SliderConfig - Slider configuration
    @return SliderObject - Slider control object
]]
function Slider.new(parent: Instance, config: SliderConfig, window): SliderObject
    config = config or {}

    local name = config.Name or SliderComponentDefaults.Name or "Slider"
    local min, max = resolveRange(config.Min, config.Max)
    local increment = resolveIncrement(config.Increment)
    local value = normalizeValue(config.Default, SliderDefaults.Value, min, max, increment)
    local description = Create.GetDescription(config)
    local hasDescription = description ~= nil
    local height = hasDescription and (Sizes.Slider.HeightWithDescription or 56)
        or Sizes.Slider.Height

    local self = BaseComponent.new(Slider, {
        Parent = parent,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height),
        Blockable = true,
        Flag = config.Flag,
        Window = window,
    })

    self._min = min
    self._max = max
    self._increment = increment
    self._value = value
    self._callback = config.Callback or function() end
    self._dragging = false

    -- Label
    Create.ComponentLabel(
        self._frame,
        name,
        hasDescription,
        Sizes.Slider.DescriptionRightPadding or 80
    )

    -- Description
    Create.Description(
        self._frame,
        description,
        UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Component.LabelLeft or 10, 0, Sizes.Slider.DescriptionTop or 22),
        UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(Sizes.Slider.DescriptionRightPadding or 80),
            0,
            Sizes.Component.DescriptionHeight or 14
        )
    )

    -- Value display
    self._valueLabel = Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "Value",
        FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
        Text = tostring(self._value),
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Position = UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(Sizes.Slider.ValueRightOffset or 60),
            0,
            hasDescription and (Sizes.Slider.HeaderTopWithDescription or 4)
                or (Sizes.Slider.HeaderTop or 5)
        ),
        TextSize = Fonts.Size.Normal,
        Size = UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Slider.ValueWidth or 50, 0, Sizes.Component.LabelHeight or 20),
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    -- Track background
    self._track = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Track",
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Background,
        Position = UDim2.new(
            0,
            Sizes.Slider.TrackHorizontalPadding or 10,
            0,
            hasDescription and (Sizes.Slider.TrackTopWithDescription or 39)
                or (Sizes.Slider.TrackTop or 29)
        ),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.new(
            1,
            -((Sizes.Slider.TrackHorizontalPadding or 10) * 2),
            0,
            Sizes.Slider.TrackHeight
        ),
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    Create.Corner(self._track, Sizes.Corner.Full)

    -- Fill bar
    local range = math.max(self._max - self._min, 1)
    local initialFill = (self._value - self._min) / range
    self._fill = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Fill",
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Accent,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.new(initialFill, 0, 1, 0),
        Parent = self._track,
    })

    Create.Corner(self._fill, Sizes.Corner.Full)

    -- Input handling
    self:Connect(self._track.InputBegan, function(input)
        if self._blocked then
            return
        end

        if
            input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        then
            self._dragging = true
            self:_UpdateFromInput(input)
        end
    end)

    self:Connect(self._track.InputEnded, function(input)
        if
            input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        then
            self._dragging = false
        end
    end)

    self:Connect(Services.UserInputService.InputChanged, function(input)
        if
            self._dragging
            and not self._blocked
            and (
                input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
            )
        then
            self:_UpdateFromInput(input)
        end
    end)

    local baseBlock = self.Block
    self.Block = function(component, text: string?)
        component._dragging = false
        baseBlock(component, text)
    end

    Create.Configurable(self, self._flag, "Slider", function()
        return self._value
    end, function(configValue)
        if type(configValue) == "number" then
            self:SetValue(configValue)
        end
    end)

    return self
end

function Slider:_UpdateFromInput(input: InputObject)
    local pos = input.Position
    local trackPos = self._track.AbsolutePosition
    local trackSize = self._track.AbsoluteSize

    local relativeX = math.clamp((pos.X - trackPos.X) / trackSize.X, 0, 1)
    local rawValue = self._min + (self._max - self._min) * relativeX

    -- Apply increment
    self._value = normalizeValue(rawValue, self._value, self._min, self._max, self._increment)

    self:_UpdateVisual()
    self._callback(self._value)
end

function Slider:_UpdateVisual()
    local range = math.max(self._max - self._min, 1)
    local fillRatio = math.clamp((self._value - self._min) / range, 0, 1)
    Tween.Create(self._fill, { Size = UDim2.new(fillRatio, 0, 1, 0) }, "Instant")
    self._valueLabel.Text = tostring(self._value)
end

function Slider:SetValue(value: number)
    self._value = normalizeValue(value, self._value, self._min, self._max, self._increment)
    self:_UpdateVisual()
    self._callback(self._value)
end

function Slider:GetValue(): number
    return self._value
end

function Slider:SetMin(min: number)
    self._min = resolveNumber(min, self._min)
    if self._max < self._min then
        self._max = self._min
    end
    self._value = normalizeValue(self._value, self._value, self._min, self._max, self._increment)
    self:_UpdateVisual()
end

function Slider:SetMax(max: number)
    self._max = resolveNumber(max, self._max)
    if self._max < self._min then
        self._min = self._max
    end
    self._value = normalizeValue(self._value, self._value, self._min, self._max, self._increment)
    self:_UpdateVisual()
end

return Slider
end

__modules["Components.Tab"] = function()
local Create = require(script.Parent.Parent.Utils.Create)
local Tween = require(script.Parent.Parent.Utils.Tween)
local Colors = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Colors)
local Sizes = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Sizes)
local Fonts = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Fonts)
local Defaults = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Defaults)
local Icons = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Icons)
local BaseComponent = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.BaseComponent)

local Button = require(script.Parent.Button)
local Toggle = require(script.Parent.Toggle)
local Slider = require(script.Parent.Slider)
local Dropdown = require(script.Parent.Dropdown)
local TextBox = require(script.Parent.TextBox)

local Tab = {}
Tab.__index = Tab
setmetatable(Tab, { __index = BaseComponent })
local ComponentDefaults = Defaults.Components or {}
local CommonDefaults = ComponentDefaults.Common or {}
local ConfigUIDefaults = ComponentDefaults.ConfigUI or {}
local ComponentIcons = Icons.Components or {}
local function closePopupsInElements(elements)
    for _, element in ipairs(elements) do
        if element then
            if type(element.Close) == "function" then
                element:Close()
            end
            if type(element._elements) == "table" then
                closePopupsInElements(element._elements)
            end
        end
    end
end

function Tab.new(window, section, name: string, icon: (string | number)?)
    local self = BaseComponent.new(Tab, {
        Parent = section._tabsContainer,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -15, 0, Sizes.Tab.Height),
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Secondary,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        StrokeColor = Colors.Border,
        StrokeTransparency = 1,
        Blockable = false,
    })

    self._window = window
    self._section = section
    self._name = name
    self._elements = {}

    self._button = self._frame
    self._stroke.LineJoinMode = Enum.LineJoinMode.Round

    self._icon = Create.Instance("ImageLabel", {
        Name = "Icon",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        ImageColor3 = Colors.TextDark,
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Tab.IconLeft or 11, 0.5, 0),
        Size = UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Tab.IconSize or 15, 0, Sizes.Tab.IconSize or 15),
        Parent = self._button,
    })
    Create.ApplyIcon(self._icon, icon, ComponentIcons.Tab)

    self._text = Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "TabText",
        FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Colors.TextDark,
        Text = name,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Position = UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Tab.TextLeft or 33, 0, 0),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -(Sizes.Tab.TextRightPadding or 42), 1, 0),
        TextSize = Fonts.Size.Small,
        Parent = self._button,
    })

    Create.Instance(
        "UIPadding",
        { PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, Sizes.Tab.TextPaddingRight or 9), Parent = self._text }
    )

    local click = Create.Instance("TextButton", {
        Name = "Click",
        Text = CommonDefaults.EmptyText or "",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        Parent = self._button,
    })

    -- Content frame
    self._content = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = name .. "_Content",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
        AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
        Visible = false,
        Parent = window:GetContentContainer(),
    })

    Create.ListLayout(self._content, Sizes.Tab.ContentPadding or 8)

    self:Connect(click.MouseButton1Click, function()
        window:SelectTab(self)
    end)

    self:Connect(click.MouseEnter, function()
        if window._currentTab ~= self then
            Tween.Create(
                self._button,
                { BackgroundTransparency = CommonDefaults.HoverFaintTransparency or 0.7 },
                "Fast"
            )
        end
    end)

    self:Connect(click.MouseLeave, function()
        if window._currentTab ~= self then
            Tween.Create(
                self._button,
                { BackgroundTransparency = CommonDefaults.Transparent or 1 },
                "Fast"
            )
        end
    end)

    if not window._currentTab then
        window:SelectTab(self)
    end

    return self
end

function Tab:_AddElement(element)
    table.insert(self._elements, element)
    return element
end

function Tab:Select()
    self._content.Visible = true
    Tween.Create(self._button, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.25 }, "Fast")
    Tween.Create(self._text, { TextColor3 = Colors.Text }, "Fast")
    Tween.Create(self._icon, { ImageColor3 = Colors.Text }, "Fast")
    self._stroke.Transparency = 0
end

function Tab:Deselect()
    self._content.Visible = false
    Tween.Create(self._button, { BackgroundTransparency = CommonDefaults.Transparent or 1 }, "Fast")
    Tween.Create(self._text, { TextColor3 = Colors.TextDark }, "Fast")
    Tween.Create(self._icon, { ImageColor3 = Colors.TextDark }, "Fast")
    self._stroke.Transparency = 1
    closePopupsInElements(self._elements)
end

-- Content helpers
function Tab:CreateSection(config)
    local ContentSection = require(script.Parent.ContentSection)
    return self:_AddElement(ContentSection.new(self, config))
end

function Tab:Paragraph(config)
    local Paragraph = require(script.Parent.Paragraph)
    return self:_AddElement(Paragraph.new(self._content, config))
end

function Tab:Button(config)
    return self:_AddElement(Button.new(self._content, config, self._window))
end

function Tab:Toggle(config)
    return self:_AddElement(Toggle.new(self._content, config, self._window))
end

function Tab:Slider(config)
    return self:_AddElement(Slider.new(self._content, config, self._window))
end

function Tab:Dropdown(config)
    return self:_AddElement(Dropdown.new(self._content, config, self._window))
end

function Tab:Keybind(config)
    local Keybind = require(script.Parent.Keybind)
    return self:_AddElement(Keybind.new(self._content, config, self._window))
end

function Tab:ColorPicker(config)
    local ColorPicker = require(script.Parent.ColorPicker)
    return self:_AddElement(ColorPicker.new(self._content, config, self._window))
end

function Tab:TextBox(config)
    return self:_AddElement(TextBox.new(self._content, config, self._window))
end

function Tab:CreateConfigSection()
    local section = self:CreateSection(ConfigUIDefaults.SectionTitle or "Configuration")
    return section:CreateConfigSection()
end

function Tab:Destroy()
    for _, element in ipairs(self._elements) do
        if element.Destroy then
            element:Destroy()
        end
    end
    table.clear(self._elements)

    if self._content then
        self._content:Destroy()
    end

    BaseComponent.Destroy(self)
end

return Tab
end

__modules["Components.TextBox"] = function()
local Create = require(script.Parent.Parent.Utils.Create)
local BaseComponent = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.BaseComponent)
local Tween = require(script.Parent.Parent.Utils.Tween)
local Colors = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Colors)
local Sizes = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Sizes)
local Fonts = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Fonts)
local Defaults = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Defaults)
local Icons = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Icons)

local TextBox = {}
TextBox.__index = TextBox
setmetatable(TextBox, { __index = BaseComponent })
local ComponentDefaults = Defaults.Components or {}
local CommonDefaults = ComponentDefaults.Common or {}
local TextBoxDefaults = ComponentDefaults.TextBox or {}
local ComponentIcons = Icons.Components or {}
local TextBoxSizes = Sizes.TextBox or {}

export type TextBoxConfig = {
    Name: string?,
    Description: string?,
    Desc: string?,
    Default: string?,
    Placeholder: string?,
    ClearOnFocus: boolean?,
    NumbersOnly: boolean?,
    Flag: string?,
    Callback: ((text: string, enterPressed: boolean) -> ())?,
}

function TextBox.new(parent: Instance, config: TextBoxConfig?, window)
    config = config or {}

    local name = config.Name or TextBoxDefaults.Name or "TextBox"
    local placeholder = config.Placeholder or TextBoxDefaults.Placeholder or "Enter text..."
    local description = Create.GetDescription(config)
    local hasDescription = description ~= nil
    local height = hasDescription
            and (TextBoxSizes.HeightWithDescription or CommonDefaults.HeightWithDescription or 50)
        or Sizes.TextBox.Height

    local self = BaseComponent.new(TextBox, {
        Parent = parent,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height),
        Blockable = true,
        Flag = config.Flag,
        Window = window,
    })

    self._callback = config.Callback or function() end
    self._text = tostring(config.Default or TextBoxDefaults.DefaultText or "")
    self._numbersOnly = if config.NumbersOnly == nil
        then (TextBoxDefaults.NumbersOnly or false)
        else config.NumbersOnly

    self._label = Create.ComponentLabel(
        self._frame,
        name,
        hasDescription,
        TextBoxSizes.LabelRightPadding or 190
    )

    Create.Description(
        self._frame,
        description,
        UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Component.LabelLeft or 10, 0, Sizes.Component.DescriptionTop or 27),
        UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(TextBoxSizes.LabelRightPadding or 190),
            0,
            Sizes.Component.DescriptionHeight or 14
        )
    )

    self._icon = Create.Instance("ImageLabel", {
        Name = "Icon",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        ImageColor3 = Colors.TextDark,
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
        Position = UDim2.new(1, -(TextBoxSizes.IconRightOffset or 165), 0.5, 0),
        Size = UDim2.new(0, TextBoxSizes.IconSize or 18, 0, TextBoxSizes.IconSize or 18),
        Parent = self._frame,
    })
    Create.ApplyIcon(self._icon, nil, ComponentIcons.TextBox)

    self._container = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "TextBoxContainer",
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Secondary,
        BackgroundTransparency = CommonDefaults.ControlTransparency or 0.04,
