        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
        Position = UDim2.new(1, -(TextBoxSizes.InputRightOffset or 10), 0.5, 0),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.new(0, Sizes.TextBox.InputWidth, 0, TextBoxSizes.InputHeight or 26),
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    Create.Corner(self._container, Sizes.Corner.Medium)
    self._stroke = Create.Stroke(self._container)

    self._input = Create.Instance("TextBox", {
        Name = "Input",
        FontFace = Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Colors.Text,
        PlaceholderText = placeholder,
        PlaceholderColor3 = Colors.TextDark,
        Text = self._text,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        TextSize = Fonts.Size.Small,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -(TextBoxSizes.InputTextRightPadding or 16), 1, 0),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, TextBoxSizes.InputTextPadding or 8, 0, 0),
        ClearTextOnFocus = if config.ClearOnFocus == nil
            then (TextBoxDefaults.ClearOnFocus or false)
            else config.ClearOnFocus,
        Parent = self._container,
    })

    self:Connect(self._input.Focused, function()
        if self._blocked then
            self._input:ReleaseFocus()
            return
        end

        Tween.Create(self._container, { BackgroundTransparency = 0 }, "Fast")
        Tween.Create(self._stroke, { Color = Colors.Accent }, "Fast")
        Tween.Create(self._icon, { ImageColor3 = Colors.Text }, "Fast")
    end)

    self:Connect(self._input.FocusLost, function(enterPressed)
        Tween.Create(
            self._container,
            { BackgroundTransparency = CommonDefaults.ControlTransparency or 0.04 },
            "Fast"
        )
        Tween.Create(self._stroke, { Color = Colors.Border }, "Fast")
        Tween.Create(self._icon, { ImageColor3 = Colors.TextDark }, "Fast")

        if self._numbersOnly then
            local numberValue = tonumber(self._input.Text)
            if numberValue then
                self._text = tostring(numberValue)
            end
            self._input.Text = self._text
        else
            self._text = self._input.Text
        end

        self._callback(self._text, enterPressed)
    end)

    if self._numbersOnly then
        self:Connect(self._input:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"), function()
            local filtered = self._input.Text:gsub("[^%d%.%-]", "")
            if self._input.Text ~= filtered then
                self._input.Text = filtered
            end
        end)
    end

    local baseBlock = self.Block
    self.Block = function(component, text: string?)
        component._input:ReleaseFocus()
        baseBlock(component, text)
    end

    Create.Configurable(self, self._flag, "TextBox", function()
        return self._text
    end, function(value)
        if type(value) == "string" then
            self:SetText(value)
        end
    end)

    return self
end

function TextBox:SetText(text: any)
    self._text = tostring(text or "")
    self._input.Text = self._text
end

function TextBox:GetText(): string
    return self._text
end

function TextBox:SetPlaceholder(placeholder: string)
    self._input.PlaceholderText = placeholder
end

function TextBox:Focus()
    if self._blocked then
        return
    end

    self._input:CaptureFocus()
end

return TextBox
end

__modules["Components.Toggle"] = function()
--[[
    AcrylicUI - Toggle Component

    A toggle switch with smooth animations.
]]

local Create = require(script.Parent.Parent.Utils.Create)
local BaseComponent = require(script.Parent.Parent.Core.BaseComponent)
local Tween = require(script.Parent.Parent.Utils.Tween)
local Colors = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Colors)
local Sizes = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Sizes)
local Defaults = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Defaults)

local Toggle = {}
Toggle.__index = Toggle
setmetatable(Toggle, { __index = BaseComponent })
local ComponentDefaults = Defaults.Components or {}
local CommonDefaults = ComponentDefaults.Common or {}
local ToggleDefaults = ComponentDefaults.Toggle or {}

export type ToggleConfig = {
    Name: string?,
    Description: string?,
    Desc: string?,
    Default: boolean?,
    Flag: string?,
    Callback: ((enabled: boolean) -> ())?,
}

export type ToggleObject = {
    SetValue: (self: ToggleObject, value: boolean, silent: boolean?) -> (),
    GetValue: (self: ToggleObject) -> boolean,
    Block: (self: ToggleObject, text: string?) -> (),
    Unblock: (self: ToggleObject) -> (),
    IsBlocked: (self: ToggleObject) -> boolean,
    Destroy: (self: ToggleObject) -> (),
}

--[[
    Creates a new toggle component

    @param parent Instance - Parent container
    @param config ToggleConfig - Toggle configuration
    @return ToggleObject - Toggle control object
]]
function Toggle.new(parent: Instance, config: ToggleConfig, window): ToggleObject
    config = config or {}

    local name = config.Name or ToggleDefaults.Name or "Toggle"
    local default = if config.Default == nil
        then (ToggleDefaults.Enabled or false)
        else config.Default
    local callback = config.Callback or function() end
    local description = Create.GetDescription(config)
    local hasDescription = description ~= nil
    local height = hasDescription
            and (Sizes.Component.HeightWithDescription or CommonDefaults.HeightWithDescription or 50)
        or Sizes.Button.Height
    local knobPadding = Sizes.Toggle.Padding or 4
    local knobEnabledX = Sizes.Toggle.Width - Sizes.Toggle.Circle - knobPadding

    local self = BaseComponent.new(Toggle, {
        Parent = parent,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, height),
        Blockable = true,
        Flag = config.Flag,
        Window = window,
    })

    self._enabled = default
    self._callback = callback

    -- Label
    self._label = Create.ComponentLabel(
        self._frame,
        name,
        hasDescription,
        Sizes.Toggle.LabelRightPadding or 60
    )

    -- Description
    Create.Description(
        self._frame,
        description,
        UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Component.LabelLeft or 10, 0, Sizes.Component.DescriptionTop or 27),
        UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(Sizes.Toggle.LabelRightPadding or 60),
            0,
            Sizes.Component.DescriptionHeight or 14
        )
    )

    -- Switch background
    self._switchBg = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "SwitchBackground",
        BackgroundColor3 = self._enabled and Colors.Toggle.Enabled or Colors.Toggle.Disabled,
        Position = UDim2.new(
            1,
            -(Sizes.Toggle.RightOffset or 48),
            0.5,
            -(Sizes.Toggle.VerticalOffset or 10)
        ),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Toggle.Width, 0, Sizes.Toggle.Height),
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    Create.Corner(self._switchBg, Sizes.Corner.Full)

    -- Switch circle
    self._circle = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Circle",
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Toggle.Circle,
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5),
        Position = if self._enabled
            then UDim2.new(0, knobEnabledX, 0.5, 0)
            else UDim2.new(0, knobPadding, 0.5, 0),
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Size = UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Toggle.Circle, 0, Sizes.Toggle.Circle),
        Parent = self._switchBg,
    })

    Create.Corner(self._circle, Sizes.Corner.Full)

    -- Click area
    local button = Create.Instance("TextButton", {
        Name = "ClickArea",
        Text = CommonDefaults.EmptyText or "",
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        Parent = self._frame,
    })

    self:Connect(button.MouseButton1Click, function()
        if self._blocked then
            return
        end

        self:SetValue(not self._enabled)
    end)

    local baseBlock = self.Block
    self.Block = function(component, text: string?)
        if component._enabled then
            component:SetValue(false)
        end

        baseBlock(component, text)
    end

    Create.Configurable(self, self._flag, "Toggle", function()
        return self._enabled
    end, function(value)
        if type(value) == "boolean" then
            self:SetValue(value, true)
        end
    end)

    return self
end

function Toggle:_UpdateVisual()
    if self._enabled then
        Tween.Create(self._switchBg, { BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Toggle.Enabled }, "Normal")
        Tween.Create(self._circle, {
            Position = UDim2.new(
                0,
                Sizes.Toggle.Width - Sizes.Toggle.Circle - (Sizes.Toggle.Padding or 4),
                0.5,
                0
            ),
        }, "Normal")
    else
        Tween.Create(self._switchBg, { BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Toggle.Disabled }, "Normal")
        Tween.Create(
            self._circle,
            { Position = UDim2.new(0, Sizes.Toggle.Padding or 4, 0.5, 0) },
            "Normal"
        )
    end
end

function Toggle:SetValue(value: boolean, silent: boolean?)
    self._enabled = value
    self:_UpdateVisual()
    if not silent then
        self._callback(self._enabled)
    end
end

function Toggle:GetValue(): boolean
    return self._enabled
end

return Toggle
end

__modules["Constants.Animation"] = function()
--[[
    AcrylicUI - Animation Constants

    Timing and easing configurations for smooth animations.
]]

local Animation = {
    -- Duration presets (in seconds)
    Duration = {
        Instant = 0.05,
        Fast = 0.1,
        Normal = 0.15,
        Slow = 0.2,
        VerySlow = 0.3,
    },

    -- Default easing style
    DefaultEasing = Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,

    -- Default easing direction
    DefaultDirection = Enum.EasingDirection.Out,

    -- Spring configurations for bouncy effects
    Spring = {
        Damping = 1,
        Frequency = 3,
    },
}

--[[
    Creates a TweenInfo with preset values

    @param duration string | number - Duration preset name or custom value
    @param easing Enum.EasingStyle? - Optional easing style
    @param direction Enum.EasingDirection? - Optional easing direction
    @return TweenInfo
]]
function Animation.CreateTweenInfo(
    duration: string | number,
    easing: Enum.EasingStyle?,
    direction: Enum.EasingDirection?
): TweenInfo
    local actualDuration = if type(duration) == "string"
        then Animation.Duration[duration] or Animation.Duration.Normal
        else duration

    return TweenInfo.new(
        actualDuration,
        easing or Animation.DefaultEasing,
        direction or Animation.DefaultDirection
    )
end

return Animation
end

__modules["Constants.Colors"] = function()
--[[
    AcrylicUI - Color Constants

    Default theme colors for the UI library.
    Supports dark mode with acrylic/glass aesthetics.
    Provides a runtime-applicable theme system via SetTheme/ResetTheme.
]]

local function deepCopy(t)
    local copy = {}
    for k, v in pairs(t) do
        if type(v) == "table" then
            copy[k] = deepCopy(v)
        else
            copy[k] = v
        end
    end
    return copy
end

local function deepMerge(base, overrides)
    local result = deepCopy(base)
    for key, value in pairs(overrides) do
        if type(value) == "table" and type(result[key]) == "table" then
            result[key] = deepMerge(result[key], value)
        else
            result[key] = value
        end
    end
    return result
end

local Colors = {
    -- Primary colors
    Background = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 12),
    Secondary = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20),
    Border = Color3.fromRGB(39, 39, 39),

    -- Text colors
    Text = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    TextDark = Color3.fromRGB(93, 93, 93),
    TextFade = Color3.fromRGB(9, 9, 9),

    -- Accent color (customizable)
    Accent = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),

    -- Toggle specific colors
    Toggle = {
        Enabled = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
        Disabled = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 32),
        Circle = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20),
    },

    -- Notification specific colors
    Notification = {
        Background = Color3.fromRGB(11, 11, 11),
        Border = Color3.fromRGB(26, 26, 26),
        Timer = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    },

    -- Window control colors
    CloseHover = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100),
    ResizeHandle = Color3.fromRGB(110, 110, 110),
    Scrollbar = Color3.fromRGB(60, 60, 60),
}

-- Frozen snapshot of factory defaults for ResetTheme
Colors._defaults = deepCopy(Colors)

--[[
    Applies a partial theme override to the active Colors table.
    Nested tables (Toggle, Notification) are deep-merged.

    @param overrides table - Partial color overrides
]]
function Colors:SetTheme(overrides: { [string]: any })
    if not overrides then
        return
    end

    for key, value in pairs(overrides) do
        if key == "_defaults" then
            continue
        end
        if type(value) == "table" and type(self[key]) == "table" then
            self[key] = deepMerge(self[key], value)
        else
            self[key] = value
        end
    end
end

--[[
    Restores all colors to the factory defaults captured at load time.
]]
function Colors:ResetTheme()
    for key, value in pairs(self._defaults) do
        if key == "_defaults" then
            continue
        end
        if type(value) == "table" then
            self[key] = deepCopy(value)
        else
            self[key] = value
        end
    end
end

--[[
    Returns a standalone copy of the current theme without the methods.

    @return table - Snapshot of current color values
]]
function Colors:Snapshot(): { [string]: any }
    local snapshot = {}
    for key, value in pairs(self) do
        if key == "_defaults" or type(value) == "function" then
            continue
        end
        if type(value) == "table" then
            snapshot[key] = deepCopy(value)
        else
            snapshot[key] = value
        end
    end
    return snapshot
end

return Colors
end
