__modules["Utils.ConfigEncryption"] = function()
--[[
    AcrylicUI - Config Encryption
    Simple byte-shift + Base64 obfuscation (Neverlose.cc pattern)
]]

local ConfigEncryption = {}

local b = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"

function ConfigEncryption.Base64Encode(data: string): string
    return (
        (data:gsub(".", function(x)
            local r, b2 = "", x:byte()
            for i = 8, 1, -1 do
                r = r .. (b2 % 2 ^ i - b2 % 2 ^ (i - 1) > 0 and "1" or "0")
            end
            return r
        end) .. "0000"):gsub("%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?", function(x)
            if #x < 6 then
                return ""
            end
            local c = 0
            for i = 1, 6 do
                c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == "1" and 2 ^ (6 - i) or 0)
            end
            return b:sub(c + 1, c + 1)
        end) .. ({ "", "==", "=" })[#data % 3 + 1]
    )
end

function ConfigEncryption.Base64Decode(data: string): string
    data = string.gsub(data, "[^" .. b .. "=]", "")
    return (
        data:gsub(".", function(x)
            if x == "=" then
                return ""
            end
            local r, f = "", (b:find(x) - 1)
            for i = 6, 1, -1 do
                r = r .. (f % 2 ^ i - f % 2 ^ (i - 1) > 0 and "1" or "0")
            end
            return r
        end):gsub("%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?", function(x)
            if #x ~= 8 then
                return ""
            end
            local c = 0
            for i = 1, 8 do
                c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == "1" and 2 ^ (8 - i) or 0)
            end
            return string.char(c)
        end)
    )
end

function ConfigEncryption.Encrypt(data: string): string
    local bytes = {}
    local encrypt_seed = ((#data + 3782) % 111) + 1

    _ = string.gsub(data, ".", function(dt)
        table.insert(bytes, tostring(dt:byte() + encrypt_seed))
    end)

    local concatbyte = table.concat(bytes, "?")
    table.clear(bytes)

    return "{" .. tostring(encrypt_seed + 72667) .. "}?" .. concatbyte
end

function ConfigEncryption.Decrypt(data: string): string
    local main_data = string.split(data, "?")
    local seed_str = main_data[1]:gsub("{", ""):gsub("}", "")
    local seed = tonumber(seed_str)

    local ks = {}
    local real_seed = seed - 72667

    for i, v in next, main_data do
        if i > 1 then
            local fake_byte = tonumber(v)
            table.insert(ks, string.char(fake_byte - real_seed))
        end
    end

    local result = table.concat(ks)
    table.clear(ks)

    return result
end

return ConfigEncryption
end

__modules["Utils.Create"] = function()
--[[
    AcrylicUI - Instance Creation Utilities

    Helper functions for creating and configuring UI instances.
]]

local Constants = {
    Colors = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Colors),
    Sizes = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Sizes),
    Fonts = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Fonts),
    Defaults = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Defaults),
    Layers = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Layers),
}

local IconResolver = require(script.Parent.IconResolver)
local Tween = require(script.Parent.Tween)

local Create = {}

local INTERNAL_PROPERTIES = {
    Parent = true,
    Name = true,
    PreserveName = true,
    RandomizeName = true,
}

local stealthNameCounter = 0
local stealthNameSeed = math.floor((os.clock() * 1000000) % 1000000000)
local _iconPartChildren: { [Instance]: boolean } = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }) :: any
local _iconPartConnections: { [ImageLabel]: { RBXScriptConnection } } = setmetatable(
    {},
    { __mode = "k" }
) :: any

local function nextStealthName(): string
    stealthNameCounter += 1
    return "_A" .. tostring(stealthNameSeed) .. "_" .. tostring(stealthNameCounter)
end

local function applyNamePolicy(instance: Instance, className: string, properties: { [string]: any })
    if properties.PreserveName == true and properties.Name ~= nil then
        instance.Name = tostring(properties.Name)
        return
    end

    if properties.RandomizeName == true or className == "ScreenGui" then
        instance.Name = nextStealthName()
    end
end

--[[
    Creates a new instance with properties

    @param className string - The class name of the instance
    @param properties table - Properties to apply
    @return Instance - The created instance

    @example
    local frame = Create.Instance("Frame", {
        Name = "Container",
        BackgroundColor3 = Colors.Background,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        Parent = screenGui
    })
]]
function Create.Instance(className: string, properties: { [string]: any }): Instance
    local instance = Instance.new(className)

    for property, value in pairs(properties) do
        if not INTERNAL_PROPERTIES[property] then
            instance[property] = value
        end
    end

    applyNamePolicy(instance, className, properties)

    -- Set parent last to avoid unnecessary property updates
    if properties.Parent then
        instance.Parent = properties.Parent
    end

    return instance
end

--[[
    Creates a UICorner with specified radius

    @param parent Instance - Parent to attach corner to
    @param radius number? - Corner radius in pixels (default: 5)
    @return UICorner
]]
function Create.Corner(parent: Instance, radius: number?): UICorner
    return Create.Instance("UICorner", {
        CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius or Constants.Sizes.Corner.Medium),
        Parent = parent,
    }) :: UICorner
end

--[[
    Creates a UIStroke border

    @param parent Instance - Parent to attach stroke to
    @param color Color3? - Stroke color (default: Border color)
    @param transparency number? - Stroke transparency (default: 0)
    @param thickness number? - Stroke thickness (default: 1)
    @return UIStroke
]]
function Create.Stroke(
    parent: Instance,
    color: Color3?,
    transparency: number?,
    thickness: number?
): UIStroke
    return Create.Instance("UIStroke", {
        ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border,
        Color = color or Constants.Colors.Border,
        Transparency = transparency or 0,
        Thickness = thickness or 1,
        Parent = parent,
    }) :: UIStroke
end

--[[
    Creates a UIPadding

    @param parent Instance - Parent to attach padding to
    @param top number? - Top padding
    @param bottom number? - Bottom padding
    @param left number? - Left padding
    @param right number? - Right padding
    @return UIPadding
]]
function Create.Padding(
    parent: Instance,
    top: number?,
    bottom: number?,
    left: number?,
    right: number?
): UIPadding
    return Create.Instance("UIPadding", {
        PaddingTop = UDim.new(0, top or 0),
        PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, bottom or 0),
        PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, left or 0),
        PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, right or 0),
        Parent = parent,
    }) :: UIPadding
end

--[[
    Creates a UIListLayout

    @param parent Instance - Parent to attach layout to
    @param padding number? - Padding between elements
    @param sortOrder Enum.SortOrder? - Sort order
    @param direction Enum.FillDirection? - Fill direction
    @return UIListLayout
]]
function Create.ListLayout(
    parent: Instance,
    padding: number?,
    sortOrder: Enum.SortOrder?,
    direction: Enum.FillDirection?
): UIListLayout
    return Create.Instance("UIListLayout", {
        Padding = UDim.new(0, padding or 0),
        SortOrder = sortOrder or Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
        FillDirection = direction or Enum.FillDirection.Vertical,
        Parent = parent,
    }) :: UIListLayout
end

--[[
    Creates a UIGridLayout

    @param parent Instance - Parent to attach layout to
    @param cellSize UDim2 - Size of each cell
    @param cellPadding UDim2? - Padding between cells
    @return UIGridLayout
]]
function Create.GridLayout(parent: Instance, cellSize: UDim2, cellPadding: UDim2?): UIGridLayout
    return Create.Instance("UIGridLayout", {
        CellSize = cellSize,
        CellPadding = cellPadding or UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 5),
        SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
        Parent = parent,
    }) :: UIGridLayout
end

function Create.GetDescription(config: { [string]: any }?): string?
    if not config then
        return nil
    end

    local description = config.Description or config.Desc
    if description == nil or description == "" then
        return nil
    end

    return tostring(description)
end

function Create.ComponentLabel(
    parent: Instance,
    text: string,
    hasDescription: boolean,
    rightPadding: number?
): TextLabel
    return Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "Label",
        FontFace = Constants.Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Constants.Colors.Text,
        Text = text,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Position = if hasDescription
            then UDim2.new(
                0,
                Constants.Sizes.Component.LabelLeft or 10,
                0,
                Constants.Sizes.Component.LabelTop or 7
            )
            else UDim2.new(
                0,
                Constants.Sizes.Component.LabelLeft or 10,
                0.5,
                -(Constants.Sizes.Component.LabelCenterOffset or 10)
            ),
        TextSize = Constants.Fonts.Size.Normal,
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -(rightPadding or 50), 0, Constants.Sizes.Component.LabelHeight or 20),
        Parent = parent,
    }) :: TextLabel
end

function Create.HoverEffect(
    trigger: GuiObject,
    target: Instance,
    hoverTransparency: number,
    normalTransparency: number,
    canHover: (() -> boolean)?
): (RBXScriptConnection, RBXScriptConnection)
    local enter = trigger.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
        if canHover and not canHover() then
            return
        end

        Tween.Create(target, { BackgroundTransparency = hoverTransparency }, "Fast")
    end)

    local leave = trigger.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
        Tween.Create(target, { BackgroundTransparency = normalTransparency }, "Fast")
    end)

    return enter, leave
end

function Create.Configurable(
    target: any,
    flag: string?,
    typeName: string,
    getter: () -> any,
    setter: (value: any) -> ()
)
    if flag and target._window and target._window.RegisterConfigElement then
        target._window:RegisterConfigElement(flag, typeName, getter, setter)
    end
end

local function syncIconParts(imageLabel: ImageLabel)
    for _, child in ipairs(imageLabel:GetChildren()) do
        if _iconPartChildren[child] and child:IsA("ImageLabel") then
            child.ImageColor3 = imageLabel.ImageColor3
            child.ImageTransparency = imageLabel.ImageTransparency
        end
    end
end

local function clearIconParts(imageLabel: ImageLabel)
    local connections = _iconPartConnections[imageLabel]
    if connections then
        _iconPartConnections[imageLabel] = nil
        for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
            connection:Disconnect()
        end
    end

    for _, child in ipairs(imageLabel:GetChildren()) do
        if _iconPartChildren[child] then
            _iconPartChildren[child] = nil
            child:Destroy()
        end
    end
end

local function applyResolvedIcon(imageLabel: ImageLabel, resolved: { [string]: any }): boolean
    if not resolved.Image then
        return false
    end

    clearIconParts(imageLabel)

    imageLabel.Image = resolved.Image
    imageLabel.ImageRectOffset = resolved.ImageRectOffset
        or resolved.ImageRectPosition
        or Vector2.zero
    imageLabel.ImageRectSize = resolved.ImageRectSize or Vector2.zero
    imageLabel.Visible = true

    local parts = resolved.Parts
    local createdPart = false
    if type(parts) == "table" then
        for index, part in ipairs(parts) do
            local partResolved = IconResolver.Resolve(part, resolved.Pack)
            if partResolved and partResolved.Image then
                local partLabel = Create.Instance("ImageLabel", {
                    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
                    ImageColor3 = imageLabel.ImageColor3,
                    ImageTransparency = imageLabel.ImageTransparency,
                    Image = partResolved.Image,
                    ImageRectOffset = partResolved.ImageRectOffset
                        or partResolved.ImageRectPosition
                        or Vector2.zero,
                    ImageRectSize = partResolved.ImageRectSize or Vector2.zero,
                    Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
                    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
                    ScaleType = imageLabel.ScaleType,
                    ZIndex = imageLabel.ZIndex + index,
                    RandomizeName = true,
                    Parent = imageLabel,
                }) :: ImageLabel

                _iconPartChildren[partLabel] = true
                createdPart = true
            end
        end
    end

    if createdPart then
        _iconPartConnections[imageLabel] = {
            imageLabel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ImageColor3"):Connect(function()
                syncIconParts(imageLabel)
            end),
            imageLabel:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ImageTransparency"):Connect(function()
                syncIconParts(imageLabel)
            end),
        }
    end

    return true
end

--[[
    Applies an icon to an ImageLabel.

    Accepts:
        "rbxassetid://12345" -> pass-through asset
        12345 / "12345"      -> normalized to rbxassetid://12345
        "solar/home-bold"    -> pack path
        "solar:home-bold"    -> WindUI-compatible pack path
        "home"               -> current default pack via IconsType
        layered descriptors   -> renders Parts as child ImageLabels
        nil / "" / unknown   -> hides the label (or applies fallbackIcon)

    @param imageLabel ImageLabel - target
    @param icon (string | number)? - the user-supplied icon value
    @param fallbackIcon (string | number)? - optional icon to use when pack
        resolution fails or the input is missing
    @return boolean - true if an icon was applied, false if hidden
]]
function Create.ApplyIcon(
    imageLabel: ImageLabel,
    icon: (string | number)?,
    fallbackIcon: (string | number)?
): boolean
    if imageLabel == nil then
        return false
    end

    local resolved = IconResolver.Resolve(icon)
    if not resolved then
        resolved = IconResolver.Resolve(fallbackIcon)
    end

    if resolved and applyResolvedIcon(imageLabel, resolved) then
        return true
    end

    clearIconParts(imageLabel)
    imageLabel.Image = ""
    imageLabel.ImageRectOffset = Vector2.zero
    imageLabel.ImageRectSize = Vector2.zero
    imageLabel.Visible = false
    return false
end

function Create.Description(
    parent: Instance,
    text: string?,
    position: UDim2,
    size: UDim2
): TextLabel?
    if not text then
        return nil
    end

    return Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "Description",
        FontFace = Constants.Fonts.Light,
        TextColor3 = Constants.Colors.TextDark,
        Text = text,
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        TextSize = Constants.Fonts.Size.Tiny,
        Position = position,
        Size = size,
        Parent = parent,
    }) :: TextLabel
end

function Create.Blockable(target: any, frame: Instance)
    target._blocked = false
    local messages = Constants.Defaults.Messages or {}
    local commonDefaults = Constants.Defaults.Components and Constants.Defaults.Components.Common
        or {}
    local blockerLayers = Constants.Layers.Blocker or {}

    target._blocker = Create.Instance("TextButton", {
        Name = "Blocker",
        Text = commonDefaults.EmptyText or "",
        AutoButtonColor = false,
        Active = true,
        BackgroundColor3 = Constants.Colors.Background,
        BackgroundTransparency = commonDefaults.BlockerTransparency or 0.22,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
        Visible = false,
        ZIndex = blockerLayers.Overlay or 1000,
        Parent = frame,
    }) :: TextButton

    Create.Corner(target._blocker, Constants.Sizes.Corner.Medium)

    target._blockerLabel = Create.Instance("TextLabel", {
        Name = "BlockerLabel",
        FontFace = Constants.Fonts.Regular,
        TextColor3 = Constants.Colors.Text,
        Text = messages.Blocked or "Blocked",
        TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center,
        TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
        TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        TextSize = Constants.Fonts.Size.Small,
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, 0),
        ZIndex = blockerLayers.Label or 1001,
        Parent = target._blocker,
    }) :: TextLabel

    function target:Block(text: string?)
        local blockText = if text == nil or tostring(text) == ""
            then (messages.Blocked or "Blocked")
            else tostring(text)
        self._blocked = true
        self._blockerLabel.Text = blockText
        self._blocker.Visible = true
    end

    function target:Unblock()
        self._blocked = false
        self._blocker.Visible = false
    end

    function target:IsBlocked(): boolean
        return self._blocked == true
    end
end

return Create
end

__modules["Utils.Device"] = function()
--[[
    AcrylicUI - Device Detection Utility

    Detects device type and capabilities.
]]

local Services = require(script.Parent.Services)
local Defaults = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Defaults)

local Device = {}
local DeviceDefaults = Defaults.Device or {}
local DEFAULT_VIEWPORT = DeviceDefaults.DefaultViewport or Vector2.new(1280, 720)

--[[
    Checks if the current device is mobile (touch only)

    @return boolean - True if mobile device
]]
function Device.IsMobile(): boolean
    return Services.UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not Services.UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled
end

--[[
    Checks if the current device is a tablet

    @return boolean - True if tablet device
]]
function Device.IsTablet(): boolean
    local viewport = Device.GetViewportSize()
    return Device.IsMobile()
        and math.min(viewport.X, viewport.Y) >= (DeviceDefaults.TabletMinShortSide or 600)
end

--[[
    Checks if the current device is a console

    @return boolean - True if console device
]]
function Device.IsConsole(): boolean
    return Services.UserInputService.GamepadEnabled
        and not Services.UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled
        and not Services.UserInputService.TouchEnabled
end

--[[
    Checks if the current device is desktop

    @return boolean - True if desktop device
]]
function Device.IsDesktop(): boolean
    return Services.UserInputService.KeyboardEnabled and Services.UserInputService.MouseEnabled
end

--[[
    Gets the safe area insets (for notched devices)

    @return { Top: number, Bottom: number, Left: number, Right: number }
]]
function Device.GetSafeAreaInsets(): { Top: number, Bottom: number, Left: number, Right: number }
    local insets = Services.GuiService:GetGuiInset()
    return {
        Top = insets.Y,
        Bottom = DeviceDefaults.SafeAreaBottom or 0,
        Left = DeviceDefaults.SafeAreaLeft or 0,
        Right = DeviceDefaults.SafeAreaRight or 0,
    }
end

--[[
    Gets the current viewport size

    @return Vector2 - Viewport dimensions
]]
function Device.GetViewportSize(): Vector2
    local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not camera then
        return DEFAULT_VIEWPORT
    end

    return camera.ViewportSize
end

return Device
end

__modules["Utils.Draggable"] = function()
--[[
    AcrylicUI - Draggable Utility

    Makes UI elements draggable with mouse and touch support.
]]

local Services = require(script.Parent.Services)

local Draggable = {}

export type DraggableConnection = {
    Disconnect: () -> (),
}

--[[
    Makes a frame draggable

    @param frame GuiObject - The frame to make draggable
    @param handle GuiObject? - Optional handle element (defaults to frame)
    @return DraggableConnection - Connection object to disconnect

    @example
    local connection = Draggable.Enable(window, titleBar)
    -- Later: connection.Disconnect()
]]
function Draggable.Enable(frame: GuiObject, handle: GuiObject?): DraggableConnection
    handle = handle or frame

    local dragging = false
    local dragInput: InputObject?
    local dragStart: Vector3
    local startPos: UDim2

    local connections: { RBXScriptConnection } = {}

    local function onInputBegan(input: InputObject)
        if
            input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        then
            dragging = true
            dragStart = input.Position
            startPos = frame.Position

            local dragInputRef = input
            local inputConnection
            inputConnection = Services.UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(endInput)
                if endInput == dragInputRef then
                    dragging = false
                    inputConnection:Disconnect()
                end
            end)

            table.insert(connections, inputConnection)
        end
    end

    local function onInputChanged(input: InputObject)
        if
            input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
        then
            dragInput = input
        end
    end

    table.insert(connections, handle.InputBegan:Connect(onInputBegan))
    table.insert(connections, handle.InputChanged:Connect(onInputChanged))

    table.insert(
        connections,
        Services.UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
            if input == dragInput and dragging then
                local delta = input.Position - dragStart
                frame.Position = UDim2.new(
                    startPos.X.Scale,
                    startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
                    startPos.Y.Scale,
                    startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
                )
            end
        end)
    )

    return {
        Disconnect = function()
            for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do
                connection:Disconnect()
            end
            table.clear(connections)
        end,
    }
end

return Draggable
end

__modules["Utils.IconResolver"] = function()
--[[
    AcrylicUI - Icon Resolver

    Resolves icon values into normalized Image descriptors.

    Supported formats:
        "rbxassetid://12345"      -> pass-through asset
        12345 / "12345"           -> normalized to rbxassetid://12345
        "solar/home-bold"         -> pack path
        "solar:home-bold"         -> WindUI-compatible pack path
        "home"                    -> current default pack via IconsType

    Custom packs can be registered at runtime with AddIcons. Remote pack
    resolution is wrapped in pcall and only triggered for known PackURLs.
]]

local IconResolver = {}

export type IconValue = string | number
export type IconDescriptor = {
    Image: string,
    ImageRectOffset: Vector2?,
    ImageRectPosition: Vector2?,
    ImageRectSize: Vector2?,
    Parts: { any }?,
    Pack: string?,
    Name: string?,
}

IconResolver.PackURLs = {
    solar = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/StyearX/Icons/main/solar/dist/Icons.lua",
    lucide = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/StyearX/Icons/main/lucide/dist/Icons.lua",
    gravity = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/StyearX/Icons/main/gravity/dist/Icons.lua",
    craft = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Footagesus/Icons/refs/heads/main/craft/dist/Icons.lua",
    geist = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Footagesus/Icons/refs/heads/main/geist/dist/Icons.lua",
    sfsymbols = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Footagesus/Icons/refs/heads/main/sfsymbols/dist/Icons.lua",
}

IconResolver.IconsType = "lucide"
IconResolver.Icons = {}

local _cache: { [string]: any } = {}
local _warned: { [string]: boolean } = {}
local _customPacks: { [string]: any } = IconResolver.Icons

local ASSET_PREFIX = "rbxassetid://"

local function normalizeAssetId(value: any): string?
    if type(value) == "number" then
        return ASSET_PREFIX .. tostring(value)
    end

    if type(value) ~= "string" then
        return nil
    end

    if string.sub(value, 1, #ASSET_PREFIX) == ASSET_PREFIX then
        return value
    end

    if string.match(value, "^%d+$") then
        return ASSET_PREFIX .. value
    end

    return nil
end

local function getExecutorEnv(): { [string]: any }?
    local genv = if type(_G) == "table" then rawget(_G, "getgenv") else nil
    if type(genv) == "function" then
        local ok, env = pcall(genv)
        if ok and type(env) == "table" then
            return env
        end
    end

    if type(_G) == "table" then
        return _G
    end

    return nil
end

local function fetchUrl(url: string): string?
    local httpGet = game["HttpGet"]
    if type(httpGet) == "function" then
        local ok, body = pcall(httpGet, game, url, true)
        if ok and type(body) == "string" then
            return body
        end
    end

    local env = getExecutorEnv()
    if env then
        local request = env.request or env.http_request
        if type(request) ~= "function" and type(env.syn) == "table" then
            request = env.syn.request
        end
        if type(request) ~= "function" and type(env.http) == "table" then
            request = env.http.request
        end

        if type(request) == "function" then
            local ok, response = pcall(request, {
                Url = url,
                Method = "GET",
            })
            if ok then
                if type(response) == "table" and type(response.Body) == "string" then
                    return response.Body
                end
                if type(response) == "string" then
                    return response
                end
            end
        end
    end

    local httpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local ok, body = pcall(function()
        return httpService:GetAsync(url, true)
    end)
    if ok and type(body) == "string" then
        return body
    end

    return nil
end

local function findPathSeparator(icon: string): number?
    local slash = string.find(icon, "/", 1, true)
    local colon = string.find(icon, ":", 1, true)

    if slash and colon then
        return if slash < colon then slash else colon
    end

    return slash or colon
end

local function normalizeDescriptor(
    entry: any,
    pack: string?,
    name: string?,
    packData: any?
): IconDescriptor?
    local directAsset = normalizeAssetId(entry)
    if directAsset then
        return {
            Image = directAsset,
            ImageRectOffset = Vector2.zero,
            ImageRectPosition = Vector2.zero,
            ImageRectSize = Vector2.zero,
            Parts = nil,
            Pack = pack,
            Name = name,
        }
    end

    if type(entry) ~= "table" then
        return nil
    end

    local image: string? = nil

    if packData and type(packData.Spritesheets) == "table" and entry.Image ~= nil then
        image = normalizeAssetId(packData.Spritesheets[tostring(entry.Image)])
    end

    if not image then
        image = normalizeAssetId(entry.Image)
    end
    if not image then
        return nil
    end

    local rectOffset = entry.ImageRectOffset or entry.ImageRectPosition or Vector2.zero
    local rectSize = entry.ImageRectSize or Vector2.zero

    return {
        Image = image,
        ImageRectOffset = rectOffset,
        ImageRectPosition = rectOffset,
        ImageRectSize = rectSize,
        Parts = entry.Parts,
        Pack = pack,
        Name = name,
    }
end

local function ensureCustomPack(packName: string): { [string]: any }
    local packData = _customPacks[packName]
    if type(packData) ~= "table" then
        packData = {
            Icons = {},
            Spritesheets = {},
        }
        _customPacks[packName] = packData
    end

    if type(packData.Icons) ~= "table" then
        packData.Icons = {}
    end
    if type(packData.Spritesheets) ~= "table" then
        packData.Spritesheets = {}
    end

    return packData
end

local function _loadPack(pack: string): any
    local url = IconResolver.PackURLs[pack]
    if not url then
        return nil
    end
    local body = fetchUrl(url)
    if type(body) ~= "string" then
        if not _warned[pack] then
            _warned[pack] = true
            warn(string.format("[AcrylicUI] Failed to fetch icon pack '%s'", pack))
        end
        return nil
    end
    local loadOk, chunk, loadErr = pcall(loadstring, body)
    if not loadOk then
        loadErr = chunk
        chunk = nil
    end
    if type(chunk) ~= "function" then
        if not _warned[pack] then
            _warned[pack] = true
            warn(
                string.format(
                    "[AcrylicUI] Failed to load icon pack '%s': %s",
                    pack,
                    tostring(loadErr)
                )
            )
        end
        return nil
    end
    local dataOk, data = pcall(chunk)
    if not dataOk or type(data) ~= "table" then
        if not _warned[pack] then
            _warned[pack] = true
            warn(string.format("[AcrylicUI] Icon pack '%s' did not return a table", pack))
        end
        return nil
    end
    return data
end

local function _lookup(packData: any, name: string): any
    if type(packData) ~= "table" then
        return nil
    end

    local direct = packData[name]
    if direct ~= nil then
        return direct
    end

    local icons = packData.Icons
    if type(icons) == "table" then
        local entry = icons[name]
        if entry ~= nil then
            return entry
        end
    end

    local spritesheets = packData.Spritesheets
    if type(spritesheets) == "table" then
        local entry = spritesheets[name]
        if entry ~= nil then
            return entry
        end
    end

    return nil
end

local function resolveFromPack(packData: any, pack: string, name: string): IconDescriptor?
    local entry = _lookup(packData, name)
    if entry == nil then
        return nil
    end

    return normalizeDescriptor(entry, pack, name, packData)
end

function IconResolver.NormalizeAssetId(icon: any): string?
    return normalizeAssetId(icon)
end

function IconResolver.IsAsset(icon: any): boolean
    if type(icon) ~= "string" then
        return false
    end

    return string.sub(icon, 1, #ASSET_PREFIX) == ASSET_PREFIX
end

function IconResolver.ParsePackPath(icon: any, defaultPack: string?)
    if icon == nil or IconResolver.IsAsset(icon) then
        return nil
    end
    if type(icon) ~= "string" then
        return nil
    end

    if icon == "" then
        return nil
    end

    local separator = findPathSeparator(icon)
    if not separator then
        return defaultPack or IconResolver.IconsType, icon
    end

    local pack = string.sub(icon, 1, separator - 1)
    local name = string.sub(icon, separator + 1)
    if pack == "" or name == "" then
        return nil
    end
    return pack, name
end

function IconResolver.AddIcons(packName: string, iconsData: { [string]: any })
    if type(packName) ~= "string" or packName == "" then
        error("AddIcons: packName must be a non-empty string", 2)
    end
    if type(iconsData) ~= "table" then
        error("AddIcons: iconsData must be a table", 2)
    end

    local packData = ensureCustomPack(packName)
    local spritesheets = iconsData.Spritesheets
    if type(spritesheets) == "table" then
        for spritesheetName, spritesheetAsset in pairs(spritesheets) do
            local normalizedAsset = normalizeAssetId(spritesheetAsset)
            if normalizedAsset then
                packData.Spritesheets[tostring(spritesheetName)] = normalizedAsset
            end
        end
    end

    local iconMap = if type(iconsData.Icons) == "table" then iconsData.Icons else iconsData

    for iconName, iconValue in pairs(iconMap) do
        if iconMap == iconsData and (iconName == "Icons" or iconName == "Spritesheets") then
            continue
        end

        local normalizedName = tostring(iconName)
        local descriptor = normalizeDescriptor(iconValue, packName, normalizedName, packData)
        if descriptor then
            packData.Icons[normalizedName] = descriptor
            packData.Spritesheets[tostring(descriptor.Image)] = descriptor.Image
        else
            warn("AddIcons: Unsupported icon data for '" .. normalizedName .. "'")
        end
    end
end

function IconResolver.SetIconsType(iconType: string)
    if type(iconType) ~= "string" or iconType == "" then
        error("SetIconsType: iconType must be a non-empty string", 2)
    end

    IconResolver.IconsType = iconType
end

function IconResolver.Resolve(icon: any, defaultPack: string?): IconDescriptor?
    local asset = normalizeAssetId(icon)
    if asset then
        return normalizeDescriptor(asset, nil, nil)
    end

    local pack, name = IconResolver.ParsePackPath(icon, defaultPack)
    if not pack then
        return nil
    end

    local customEntry = resolveFromPack(_customPacks[pack], pack, name)
    if customEntry then
        return customEntry
    end

    if not IconResolver.PackURLs[pack] then
        return nil
    end
    if _cache[pack] == false then
        return nil
    end

    local packData = _cache[pack]
    if packData == nil then
        packData = _loadPack(pack)
        if packData == nil then
            _cache[pack] = false
            return nil
        end
        _cache[pack] = packData
    end

    return resolveFromPack(packData, pack, name)
end

return IconResolver
end

__modules["Utils.RandomString"] = function()
--[[
    AcrylicUI - Random String Generator
    Generates random strings with control characters for anti-detection
]]

local RandomString = {}

function RandomString.new(length: number?): string
    length = length or 30
    local chars = {}
    for i = 1, length do
        chars[i] = string.char(math.random(1, 7))
    end
    return table.concat(chars)
end

return RandomString
end

__modules["Utils.Services"] = function()
--[[
    Acrylic UI Library
    Services Module - Centralized service management

    @author Acrylic Team
    @version 2.0.0
    @license MIT
]]

local function safeGet(name: string): any?
    local sources = {}

    if type(_G) == "table" then
        local getgenv = rawget(_G, "getgenv")
        if type(getgenv) == "function" then
            local ok, env = pcall(getgenv)
            if ok and type(env) == "table" then
                table.insert(sources, env)
            end
        end
    end

    local ok, env = pcall(function()
        if type(getfenv) == "function" then
            return getfenv()
        end
        return nil
    end)
    if ok and type(env) == "table" then
        table.insert(sources, env)
    end

    table.insert(sources, _G)

    for _, source in ipairs(sources) do
        if type(source) == "table" then
            local value = rawget(source, name)
            if value ~= nil then
                return value
            end
        end
    end

    return nil
end

local cloneref = safeGet("cloneref")
if type(cloneref) ~= "function" then
    cloneref = function(s)
        return s
    end
end

-- Executor GUI protection fallback order: protect_gui or protectgui or syn.protect_gui.
local ProtectGui = safeGet("protect_gui") or safeGet("protectgui")
local synEnv = safeGet("syn")
if type(ProtectGui) ~= "function" and type(synEnv) == "table" then
    ProtectGui = synEnv.protect_gui
end
if type(ProtectGui) ~= "function" then
    ProtectGui = function(s)
        return s
    end
end

local Services = {
    TweenService = cloneref(game:GetService("TweenService")),
    UserInputService = cloneref(game:GetService("UserInputService")),
    Players = cloneref(game:GetService("Players")),
    Lighting = cloneref(game:GetService("Lighting")),
    RunService = cloneref(game:GetService("RunService")),
    GuiService = cloneref(game:GetService("GuiService")),
    HttpService = cloneref(game:GetService("HttpService")),
    TextService = cloneref(game:GetService("TextService")),
}

Services.Protection = {
    cloneref = cloneref,
    ProtectGui = ProtectGui,
}

return Services
end

__modules["Utils.Tween"] = function()
--[[
    AcrylicUI - Tween Utilities

    Animation helper functions using TweenService.
]]

local Services = require(script.Parent.Services)
local Animation = require(script.Parent.Parent.Constants.Animation)

local Tween = {}

-- Active tweens cache for cleanup
local ActiveTweens: { [Instance]: Tween } = {}

--[[
    Creates and plays a tween animation

    @param instance Instance - The instance to animate
    @param properties table - Properties to animate
    @param duration number | string? - Duration or preset name
    @param easingStyle Enum.EasingStyle? - Easing style
    @param easingDirection Enum.EasingDirection? - Easing direction
    @return Tween - The created tween

    @example
    Tween.Create(button, { BackgroundTransparency = 0.5 }, "Fast")
]]
function Tween.Create(
    instance: Instance,
    properties: { [string]: any },
    duration: (number | string)?,
    easingStyle: Enum.EasingStyle?,
    easingDirection: Enum.EasingDirection?
): Tween
    -- Cancel existing tween on same instance
    if ActiveTweens[instance] then
        ActiveTweens[instance]:Cancel()
    end

    local tweenInfo = Animation.CreateTweenInfo(
        duration or Animation.Duration.Normal,
        easingStyle,
        easingDirection
    )

    local tween = Services.TweenService:Create(instance, tweenInfo, properties)
    ActiveTweens[instance] = tween

    tween.Completed:Connect(function()
        if ActiveTweens[instance] == tween then
            ActiveTweens[instance] = nil
        end
    end)

    tween:Play()
    return tween
end

--[[
    Creates a tween with callback on completion

    @param instance Instance - The instance to animate
    @param properties table - Properties to animate
    @param duration number | string? - Duration or preset name
    @param callback function - Function to call on completion
    @return Tween
]]
function Tween.CreateWithCallback(
    instance: Instance,
    properties: { [string]: any },
    duration: (number | string)?,
    callback: () -> ()
): Tween
    local tween = Tween.Create(instance, properties, duration)
    tween.Completed:Connect(callback)
    return tween
end

--[[
    Cancels all active tweens
]]
function Tween.CancelAll()
    for _, tween in pairs(ActiveTweens) do
        tween:Cancel()
    end
    table.clear(ActiveTweens)
end

--[[
    Cancels tween for specific instance

    @param instance Instance - The instance to cancel tween for
]]
function Tween.Cancel(instance: Instance)
    if ActiveTweens[instance] then
        ActiveTweens[instance]:Cancel()
        ActiveTweens[instance] = nil
    end
end

return Tween
end

return __require("init")
